item.title: 提出 SGKDiv 方法，通过将成对前馈通道构建为知识单元并采用校准的条件化路由，在不引入参数开销和 SVD 重新参数化的情况下学习生成知识的共享与专门化，从而在保持分布内生成质量的同时支持选择性的下游复用。
item.description:
面向可分解生成模型的特异性引导知识分流

Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion for Decomposable Generative Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21352

提出 SGKDiv 方法，通过将成对前馈通道构建为知识单元并采用校准的条件化路由，在不引入参数开销和 SVD 重新参数化的情况下学习生成知识的共享与专门化，从而在保持分布内生成质量的同时支持选择性的下游复用。

生成模型预训练通常将模型作为一个整体进行优化，而没有显式地组织其参数以供选择性复用。可分解预训练则学习可复用的组件用于下游适配，同时保持强大的生成性能。然而，现有的知识分流方法通过权重分解会带来大量参数开销，并且依赖固定的组件分配来诱导专门化，这可能损害分布内的生成质量。因此，我们提出了特异性引导知识分流（SGKDiv），它学习生成知识如何被共享和专门化，以实现有效的生成和选择性的下游复用。SGKDiv 从成对的前馈通道构建知识单元，在不进行基于 SVD 的重新参数化的情况下保留原生的计算结构。校准的按条件路由将共享使用先验与条件调整相结合……

arXiv:2611.21352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative model pre-training typically optimizes a model as a whole without explicitly organizing its parameters for selective reuse. Decomposable pre-training instead learns reusable components for downstream adaptation while retaining strong generative performance. However, existing knowledge diversion methods incur substantial parameter overhead through weight factorization and rely on fixed component assignments to induce specialization, potentially compromising in-distribution generation quality. We therefore propose Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion (SGKDiv), which learns how generative knowledge is shared and specialized for effective generation and selective downstream reuse. SGKDiv constructs Knowledge Units from paired feed-forward channels, preserving native computational structure without SVD-based reparameterization. Calibrated condition-wise routing combines a shared usage prior with conditional adjustments, while com

item.title: 该论文首次利用稀疏自编码器系统考察了模型自消耗训练循环中内部表征的跨代演变，发现在多代自消耗后，先前训练的SAE的可靠性会随代际推移而下降，揭示了自消耗训练对模型内部表征结构的深层影响。
item.description:
自消耗训练下的表征变化：稀疏自编码器分析

Representational Change Under Self-Consuming Training: A Sparse Autoencoder Analysis

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21348

该论文首次利用稀疏自编码器系统考察了模型自消耗训练循环中内部表征的跨代演变，发现在多代自消耗后，先前训练的SAE的可靠性会随代际推移而下降，揭示了自消耗训练对模型内部表征结构的深层影响。

大型语言模型越来越多地接触到模型生成的文本，这引发了未来模型可能在上一代模型输出上进行递归训练的可能性。先前关于这种自消耗训练循环的研究主要聚焦于输出质量和下游性能，而其对内部表征的影响尚缺乏深入理解。我们研究了表征在五代自消耗过程中的演变方式，以及稀疏自编码器（SAE）在这一转变下是否依然可靠。在每一代中，我们将基于合成数据训练的模型谱系与在相同训练设置下基于真实数据训练的匹配对照组进行比较。我们评估了在自消耗发生之前训练的SAE向后续各代迁移的效果，并在不同的SAE宽度、架构和模型层上测量了重建质量与稀疏性。随后，我们在每一代模型上对原始SAE进行微调，并利用稀疏探测来检验任务相关的特征（此处摘要不完整）

arXiv:2611.21348v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models are increasingly exposed to model-generated text, raising the possibility that future models will be trained recursively on the outputs of their predecessors. Prior work on such self-consuming training loops has largely focused on output quality and downstream performance, leaving their effects on internal representations poorly understood. We study how representations evolve across five generations of self-consumption and whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) remain reliable under this shift. At each generation, we compare a lineage trained on synthetic data with a matched control trained on real data under the same training settings. We evaluate how well SAEs trained before self-consumption transfer to later generations, measuring reconstruction and sparsity across SAE widths, architectures, and model layers. We then fine-tune the original SAE on each generation and use sparse probing to test whether task-relevant

item.title: TEMPO提出了一种两阶段的流动状态感知算子学习框架，通过期望最大化在离线阶段自动发现潜在解形态并为每种形态适配专用POD基，再在在线阶段利用门控网络将输入路由至对应分支，从而克服了单一全局低秩基无法同时表达光滑扩散解与激波等性质迥异解形态的缺陷。
item.description:
TEMPO：基于局部自适应POD基的流动状态感知算子学习

TEMPO: Regime-Aware Operator Learning with Locally Adapted POD Bases

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21344

TEMPO提出了一种两阶段的流动状态感知算子学习框架，通过期望最大化在离线阶段自动发现潜在解形态并为每种形态适配专用POD基，再在在线阶段利用门控网络将输入路由至对应分支，从而克服了单一全局低秩基无法同时表达光滑扩散解与激波等性质迥异解形态的缺陷。

算子学习从数据中逼近参数化偏微分方程的解映射，从而能够在新参数取值下实现快速预测而无需重复模拟。目前主流的方法是对所有解快照拟合单一的全局低秩基，通常采用本征正交分解（POD）。然而，当快照跨越性质截然不同的解形态——从光滑的扩散剖面到近乎不连续的激波——时，这种方法会失效。我们提出TEMPO（Trajectory Expectation-Maximization Mixture of POD Operators，POD算子的轨迹期望最大化混合模型），这是一个面向流动状态感知算子学习的两阶段框架。在离线阶段，TEMPO通过期望最大化算法恢复潜在的流动状态，并为每个被发现的状态拟合专用的线性或非线性基；在在线阶段，门控网络与每个状态各自的分支网络被联合训练，在推理时将新输入路由到相应的状态。我们在Burgers流、Sod激波管、Coanda流等问题上对TEMPO进行了测试（摘要原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.21344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Operator learning approximates the solution map of a parametric partial differential equation from data, enabling fast prediction at new parameter values without repeated simulation. The dominant approach fits a single global low-rank basis, typically a proper orthogonal decomposition (POD), to all solution snapshots. This fails when the snapshots span qualitatively different solution shapes, from smooth diffusive profiles to near-discontinuous shocks. We propose TEMPO (Trajectory Expectation-Maximization Mixture of POD Operators), a two-phase framework for regime-aware operator learning. In the offline phase, TEMPO recovers latent regimes via expectation-maximization, fitting a dedicated linear or nonlinear basis to each discovered regime. In the online phase, a gating network and per-regime branch networks are trained jointly, routing new inputs to the regimes at inference. We test TEMPO on Burgers' flow, Sod shock tubes, Coanda fl

item.title: 提出AMRT共享神经解码框架，通过“速度估计锚定局部运动、长时程精化轨迹”的两阶段设计，实现跨受试者、跨任务和跨电极配置的可泛化连续神经运动解码。
item.description:
锚定运动，精化轨迹：可泛化的连续神经解码

Anchoring Motion, Refining Trajectories: Generalizable Continuous Neural Decoding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21335

提出AMRT共享神经解码框架，通过“速度估计锚定局部运动、长时程精化轨迹”的两阶段设计，实现跨受试者、跨任务和跨电极配置的可泛化连续神经运动解码。

脑活动在多个时间尺度上编码运动信息，使连续神经控制超越离散动作识别成为可能。然而，现有方法通常针对特定受试者和任务定制，其直接的神经到运动学映射容易将受试者特异的神经变异性与任务相关的运动模式纠缠在一起，从而限制了泛化能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出了AMRT，一个面向异构电极配置和运动范式的共享神经解码框架。受皮层对运动方向和速度编码机制的启发，AMRT采用两阶段设计：先通过速度估计锚定局部运动，再在更长的时间范围内精化由此得到的轨迹，从而促进局部运动倾向在不同受试者和任务间的复用。在三个数据集上的实验表明，AMRT能够泛化到未见过的试验和受试者，并展现出跨神经记录数据的迁移潜力。

arXiv:2611.21335v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Brain activity encodes motor information across multiple temporal scales, enabling continuous neural control beyond discrete action recognition. However, existing methods are typically tailored to specific subjects and tasks, with direct neural-to-kinematic mappings that can entangle subject-specific neural variability with task-dependent motion patterns, limiting generalization. To address these limitations, we introduce AMRT, a shared neural decoding framework for heterogeneous electrode configurations and movement paradigms. Motivated by cortical encoding of movement direction and speed, AMRT adopts a two-stage design that anchors local motion through velocity estimation and refines the resulting trajectories over longer horizons, encouraging reuse of local motion tendencies across subjects and tasks. Across three datasets, AMRT generalizes to unseen trials and subjects and demonstrates transfer potential across neural recordings an

item.title: 本文提出一种将可学习离散小波变换的逐尺度能量图转化为可变长度补丁的动态分块时间序列预测方法，并发现大部分性能提升源于多分辨率分解本身而非可学习的小波滤波器。
item.description:
基于小波能量驱动的动态分块时间序列预测方法

Wavelet-Energy-Driven Dynamic Patching for Time Series Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21319

本文提出一种将可学习离散小波变换的逐尺度能量图转化为可变长度补丁的动态分块时间序列预测方法，并发现大部分性能提升源于多分辨率分解本身而非可学习的小波滤波器。

基于补丁的Transformer将时间序列标记为固定大小、均匀的窗口，这使得模型只能采用单一的时间分辨率，而真实世界的信号往往是多尺度的。离散小波变换（DWT）是一种天然的替代方案，因为它可以跨尺度对信号进行分解。目前越来越多的工作使小波滤波器变得可学习，其背后的假设是更灵活的小波能带来更好的预测效果。然而这一假设很少被单独验证，因为单次报告的性能提升通常同时归功于三个因素：使用了某种多分辨率分解、对小波的选择，以及对滤波器的训练。我们提出了一种预测器，它利用可学习DWT生成的逐尺度能量图，通过合并共享主导尺度的相邻窗口，将其转换为可变长度的补丁。由此我们得到三个发现：第一，大部分性能提升在任何滤波器被学习之前就已经存在，冻结的小波在八……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.21319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Patch-based transformers tokenise a time series into fixed-size, uniform windows, which commits the model to a single temporal resolution even though real signals are multi-scale. The discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is a natural alternative because it decomposes a signal across scales. A growing body of work makes the wavelet filter learnable, on the assumption that a more flexible wavelet forecasts better. That assumption has rarely been tested in isolation, because a single reported improvement usually credits three things at once. These are the use of any multi-resolution decomposition, the choice of wavelet and training the filter. We introduce a forecaster that turns a learnable-DWT per-scale energy map into variable-length patches by merging adjacent windows that share a dominant scale. Three findings follow. First, most of the improvement is there before any filter is learned. A frozen wavelet beats a fixed-patch baseline on eigh

item.title: 该论文提出一种免训练的权重烘焙方法：AI 分析模型通过读取目标语言模型潜在空间的拓扑描述符，并利用闭式岭回归将变换写入前馈权重，无需梯度训练即可改善潜在空间的组织（提升类别纯度），同时不损害基准性能。
item.description:
AI 能使模型的几何结构更成熟吗？大语言模型中的免训练权重烘焙

Can AI Mature a Model's Geometry? Training-Free Weight Baking in LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21310

该论文提出一种免训练的权重烘焙方法：AI 分析模型通过读取目标语言模型潜在空间的拓扑描述符，并利用闭式岭回归将变换写入前馈权重，无需梯度训练即可改善潜在空间的组织（提升类别纯度），同时不损害基准性能。

AI 能否仅通过观察潜在空间的几何结构，就使一个已训练的语言模型更加成熟（即拥有组织更良好的潜在空间）？一个分析模型读取冻结目标模型各层拓扑描述符的固定大小摘要，并提出一种变换，该变换通过闭式岭回归被写入前馈权重，无需任何梯度训练。使用轻量级模型的 126 次运行实验表明：未见过的词汇和句子上的类别纯度有所提升，基准测试准确率保持在采样误差范围内，且该分析模型以更温和的编辑方式达到了与类别感知启发式方法相当的效果。在五模型循环实验中，16 对模型提升了纯度，另有 4 对模型的目标保持不变。这些结果为未来在不使用原始权重的情况下、由大语言模型引导的免训练模型编辑工作提供了基线。

arXiv:2611.21310v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Can an AI make a trained language model more mature, in the sense of a better organized latent space, by looking only at the geometry of that space? An analyst model reads a fixed-size digest of topological descriptors of the layers of a frozen target and proposes a transformation, which closed-form ridge regression writes into the feed-forward weights without gradient training. Using lightweight models, 126 runs show that category purity rose on unseen words and sentences, benchmark accuracy stayed within sampling error, and the analyst matched a category-aware heuristic with gentler edits. In a five-model round robin approach, 16 pairs raised purity and four left the target unchanged. The results provide a baseline for future work on LLM-guided, training-free model editing without using raw weights.

item.title: 本文提出可编程语义干预（PSI），让研究者通过“语义程序”直接定义变量可产生的答案及干预应产生的答案，从而摆脱对完整反事实数据集的依赖，学习到与可解释模型变量对齐的低秩激活子空间。
item.description:
可编程语义干预：从行为程序中学习因果载体

Programmable Semantic Interventions: Learning Causal Carriers from Behavioral Programs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21307

本文提出可编程语义干预（PSI），让研究者通过“语义程序”直接定义变量可产生的答案及干预应产生的答案，从而摆脱对完整反事实数据集的依赖，学习到与可解释模型变量对齐的低秩激活子空间。

因果抽象通过将冻结网络的激活与一个更简单、可解释的模型的变量进行对齐，并检验对两者施加的干预是否一致，从而解释该网络。目前，找到这种对齐需要一个反事实数据集：即对于每一对提示，当变量被改变后网络应当给出的答案。在实践中，这些标签由该行为的可执行算法生成，而该算法是在研究应当实现该行为的模型之前编写的。然而，这些方法所优化的准则仅利用了干预应当产生的答案。在此，我们开发了一种方法，使研究者可以直接定义这种关系：变量能够产生的答案，以及干预应当从中产生哪些答案。我们将这种接口称为语义程序，并引入了可编程语义干预（PSI）：一个通过学习得到的低秩激活子空间，使得交换该子空间会改变模型的（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.21307v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Causal abstraction explains a frozen network by aligning its activations with the variables of a simpler, interpretable model, and checking that interventions on the two agree. Finding such an alignment currently requires a counterfactual dataset: for every pair of prompts, the answer the network ought to give once the variable has been changed. In practice, those labels are produced by an executable algorithm for the behavior, written before studying the model supposed to implement it. However, the criterion these methods optimize only leverages the answer an intervention should produce. Here, we develop an approach that lets the investigator define that relationship directly: the answers the variable can produce, and which of them an intervention should yield. We call this interface a semantic program and introduce Programmable Semantic Interventions (PSI): a low-rank activation subspace learned so that interchanging it changes the m

item.title: 本文针对临界阻尼Metropolis调整动能朗之万方法，同时在水条件数与维度两方面证明了混合加速性：在强凸、梯度与Hessian Lipschitz条件下，仅需 𝒪((κ^{1/2}+L_H^{1/2}m^{-3/4})d^{1/4}) 次梯度评估即可在总变差意义下混合到 ε 精度，且结果对高概率区域任意起点一致成立并适用于温启动。
item.description:
基于Dobrushin收缩与加速哈密顿蒙特卡洛的高概率一致混合

High-probability Uniform Mixing via Dobrushin Contraction and Accelerated Hamiltonian Monte Carlo

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21305

本文针对临界阻尼Metropolis调整动能朗之万方法，同时在水条件数与维度两方面证明了混合加速性：在强凸、梯度与Hessian Lipschitz条件下，仅需 𝒪((κ^{1/2}+L_H^{1/2}m^{-3/4})d^{1/4}) 次梯度评估即可在总变差意义下混合到 ε 精度，且结果对高概率区域任意起点一致成立并适用于温启动。

自哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）问世并得到广泛应用以来，其动因在于相比扩散型方法，它能够在条件数依赖和维度依赖两个方面加速向平衡态的收敛。在本工作中，我们针对带有持续均匀刷新的临界阻尼Metropolis调整动能朗之万方法，同时在这两个方面建立了这种加速性。更精确地说，对于目标测度 μ(dx) ∝ e^{-U(x)}dx，其中势函数满足 m-强凸、L-梯度Lipschitz 以及 L_H-Frobenius Hessian Lipschitz 条件，我们证明该方法在总变差意义下混合到 ε-精度，所需梯度评估次数为 𝒪((κ^{1/2} + L_H^{1/2} m^{-3/4}) d^{1/4})（相差对数因子），且该结果既对处于高平衡概率区域内的所有起始点一致成立，也对温启动成立。证明过程融合了 Bou-Rabee 等人先前研究的……

arXiv:2611.21305v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, since its invention and subsequent rise to widespread use, has been motivated by its ability to accelerate convergence to equilibrium compared to diffusive methods, both in terms of dependence on condition number and dimension. In the present work, we establish this acceleration simultaneously in both aspects for critically damped Metropolis-adjusted kinetic Langevin with persistent uniforms. More precisely, for target measures $\mu(dx)\propto e^{-U(x)}dx$ with $m$-strongly convex, $L$-gradient Lipschitz, and $L_H$-Frobenius Hessian Lipschitz potentials, we show that the method mixes to $\varepsilon$-accuracy in total variation using $\mathcal O\bigl((\kappa^{1/2}+L_H^{1/2}m^{-3/4})\,d^{1/4}\bigr)$ gradient evaluations up to logarithmic factors, both uniformly over starting points in domains of high equilibrium probability and from warm starts. The proof incorporates ideas from previous studies by Bou-Rabee and

item.title: 这是一套专为具有物理或数学背景的读者编写的深度学习入门讲义，以物理直觉为主线，内容涵盖从线性回归、神经网络基础到注意力机制等现代机器学习的核心主题。
item.description:
面向物理学家的深度学习：从线性回归到推理模型

Deep Learning for Physicists: From Linear Regression to Reasoning Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21295

这是一套专为具有物理或数学背景的读者编写的深度学习入门讲义，以物理直觉为主线，内容涵盖从线性回归、神经网络基础到注意力机制等现代机器学习的核心主题。

这些讲义基于作者于2023/24和2024/25学年在伦敦玛丽女王大学数学科学学院教授的神经网络与深度学习入门课程。不过，作者是一位物理学家，这一点在讲义中显而易见：在可能的情况下，各种概念都通过物理直觉而非繁重的形式化方法来阐释。因此，具有物理学或数学背景、希望找到一条自足的入门路径进入现代机器学习的读者，可能会觉得这些讲义格外友好。讲义从最大似然、最小二乘、线性回归和（随机）梯度下降开始，随后涵盖神经网络、反向传播、梯度消失问题、批归一化与层归一化、过拟合与正则化、对抗样本以及核方法。后半部分转向自然语言处理：词嵌入、循环网络与LSTM、注意力机制……

arXiv:2611.21295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: These lecture notes are based on an introductory course on neural networks and deep learning that the author taught in the School of Mathematical Sciences at Queen Mary University of London in 2023/24 and 2024/25. The author, however, is a physicist, and it shows: wherever possible, ideas are explained with physical intuition rather than heavy formalism. Readers with a background in physics or mathematics who want a self-contained, introductory route into modern machine learning may therefore find these notes particularly friendly. The notes start from maximum likelihood, least squares, linear regression and (stochastic) gradient descent. They then cover neural networks, backpropagation, the vanishing gradient problem, batch and layer normalization, overfitting and regularization, adversarial examples, and the kernel method. item.title: 该论文提出压缩式基于模拟的推断方法，通过仅用 $2p+1$ 个随机低维草图即可实现后验一致性，从而避免手工设计摘要统计量的困难和学习摘要的高昂计算成本，实现海量数据下的神经后验估计。
item.description:
压缩式基于模拟的推断：利用低维草图实现海量数据的神经后验估计

Compressed Simulation-Based Inference: Neural Posterior Estimation for Massive Data via Low-Dimensional Sketches

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21286

该论文提出压缩式基于模拟的推断方法，通过仅用 $2p+1$ 个随机低维草图即可实现后验一致性，从而避免手工设计摘要统计量的困难和学习摘要的高昂计算成本，实现海量数据下的神经后验估计。

神经后验估计（NPE）是一种流行的贝叶斯基于模拟的推断（SBI）方法，它使用在模拟数据-参数对上训练的神经网络，在给定用户选择的先验条件下近似后验分布。对于高维观测数据，由于维数灾难，NPE方法通常近似参数在用户选择或学习得到的摘要统计量条件下的条件密度，而非整个数据集。然而，这两种方法都面临挑战：为复杂模型手工设计良好的摘要统计量需要科学家付出大量努力，而从海量数据集中学习摘要统计量的计算代价可能过于高昂。为解决这些挑战，我们提出近似参数在数据低维草图条件下的条件密度。我们证明，对于一个具有 $p$ 维参数的模型，仅需 $2p+1$ 个随机草图即可保证后验一致性。我们比较……（摘要此处截断）

arXiv:2611.21286v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural posterior estimation (NPE) is a popular Bayesian simulation-based inference (SBI) approach that uses neural networks trained on simulated data--parameter pairs to approximate the posterior given a user-chosen prior. For high-dimensional observations, NPE methods typically approximate the conditional density of the parameter given a user-chosen or learned summary statistic, rather than the entire dataset, due to the curse of dimensionality. However, both approaches face challenges: hand-crafting good summaries for complex models requires considerable effort from scientists, while learning them from massive datasets can be prohibitively computationally expensive. To address these challenges, we propose approximating the conditional density of a parameter given low-dimensional sketches of the data. We show that, for a model with a $p$-dimensional parameter, only $2p+1$ random sketches are needed for posterior consistency. We compar

item.title: 本文在广播树模型上证明：无规划的并行采样所需轮数的指数恰好在重构阈值处达到峰值 $1/2$，而采用“先规划、后并行填充”的解码器仅需 $\log_b n+1$ 轮，从而定量刻画了“不规划”的代价。
item.description:
不规划的代价：并行采样深度在重构阈值处达到峰值

The Price of Not Planning: Parallel Sampling Depth Peaks at the Reconstruction Threshold

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21285

本文在广播树模型上证明：无规划的并行采样所需轮数的指数恰好在重构阈值处达到峰值 $1/2$，而采用“先规划、后并行填充”的解码器仅需 $\log_b n+1$ 轮，从而定量刻画了“不规划”的代价。

掩码扩散模型在每一轮中独立地采样各个 token。规划式解码器先生成一个粗略计划，然后再并行填充 token。我们探讨：计划何时能节省轮数、能节省多少轮，以及计划需要多精细。我们在广播树上研究这一问题：叶子节点对应 token，内部节点对应计划，边相关性 $\theta$ 决定 token 对计划的依赖强度。误差以前向 Kullback-Leibler 散度 $\varepsilon$ 度量，且这些下界对每一个确定性的价值自适应规则都成立，即便使用学习到的条件分布也是如此。我们证明：没有计划的解码器在重构阈值以下需要 $\min\{n,(n/\varepsilon)^{\alpha}\}$ 量级的轮数，其中 $\alpha=\log b/(4\log(1/\theta))$ 在阈值处升至 $1/2$，而在阈值之上该指数保持在 $1/2$ 以下（二值信道：$0.02\le\theta\le0.98$）。有了计划，$\log_b n+1$ 轮即可足够。在二值模型中……（原文摘要此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.21285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Masked diffusion models sample the tokens of one round independently. Planned decoders first generate a coarse plan, then fill in the tokens in parallel. We ask when a plan saves rounds, how many it saves, and how fine it must be. We study this on broadcast trees: the leaves are the tokens, the internal nodes are the plan, and the edge correlation $\theta$ sets how strongly tokens depend on the plan. Errors are measured by the forward Kullback-Leibler divergence $\varepsilon$, and the lower bounds hold for every deterministic value-adaptive rule, also with learned conditionals. We show that a decoder without the plan needs of order $\min\{n,(n/\varepsilon)^{\alpha}\}$ rounds below the reconstruction threshold, where $\alpha=\log b/(4\log(1/\theta))$ rises to $1/2$ at the threshold, and that the exponent stays below $1/2$ above it (binary channel: $0.02\le\theta\le0.98$). With the plan, $\log_b n+1$ rounds suffice. In the binary model bel

item.title: 提出SAGA训练正则化方法，利用中心核对齐将神经分子表示与指纹Tanimoto相似性对齐，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升分子语言模型的分子-文本检索和性质预测性能，使表示更符合经典化学结构关系。
item.description:
经典结构先验提升分子语言模型中的神经分子表示

Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21276

提出SAGA训练正则化方法，利用中心核对齐将神经分子表示与指纹Tanimoto相似性对齐，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升分子语言模型的分子-文本检索和性质预测性能，使表示更符合经典化学结构关系。

经典分子相似性是化学信息系统的核心，然而在结构-文本配对数据上训练的分子语言模型并不一定按照梯度化的结构关系来组织分子嵌入。在此，我们提出了结构感知引导对齐，这是一种仅在训练阶段使用的正则化方法，它利用中心核对齐将神经分子表示与基于分子指纹的Tanimoto相似性对齐，既不增加参数，也无需在推理时使用分子指纹。在MolCA和Atomas模型中，SAGA提升了分子-文本检索性能，使非精确检索的结果更偏向结构更接近的类似物，并提高了基于骨架划分的性质预测的平均性能，同时分子描述生成和文本到分子的生成在单次运行的消融实验中得到改善或保持不变。这些结果表明，成熟的化学信息学先验可以使分子语言表示在化学上更加忠实……

arXiv:2611.21276v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. item.title: 该论文证明Transformer可以通过“粗搜索初始化+局部强凸区域梯度下降”的两阶段近似最大似然程序，从含噪轨迹观测中对一般非凸的参数化常微分方程实现上下文参数估计与轨迹预测。
item.description:
参数化常微分方程的上下文估计与预测

In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21268

该论文证明Transformer可以通过“粗搜索初始化+局部强凸区域梯度下降”的两阶段近似最大似然程序，从含噪轨迹观测中对一般非凸的参数化常微分方程实现上下文参数估计与轨迹预测。

Transformer已经展示了执行上下文学习的能力，即无需更新自身参数，仅凭少量示例就能适应新任务。现有理论主要集中于模拟基于梯度的算法来解决凸统计问题，或建立一般性的函数逼近保证，而未能利用问题背后的统计结构。我们研究参数化常微分方程（ODE）的上下文参数估计与轨迹预测问题，其中参数估计通常是非凸的。在适当的可辨识性和正则性条件下，我们构建了一个Transformer，通过两阶段近似最大似然过程从含噪轨迹观测中估计未知系统参数：首先由粗搜索提供处于局部强凸区域内的初始化，随后执行具有局部线性收缩性的梯度下降。对于预测任务，我们将该估计器组合到后续过程中（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.21268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. item.title: 提出免训练的概率预测方法共形专家池（CEP），通过简单预测器池及其历史误差自适应构建预测分布，在232个数据集基准上全面超越CSP，典型数据集CRPS降低14%、MSIS降低23%。
item.description:
共形专家池：超越季节性的免训练概率时间序列预测

Conformal Expert Pools: Training-Free Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting Beyond Seasonality

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21267

提出免训练的概率预测方法共形专家池（CEP），通过简单预测器池及其历史误差自适应构建预测分布，在232个数据集基准上全面超越CSP，典型数据集CRPS降低14%、MSIS降低23%。

共形季节池表明，一个完全无需训练的预测器，仅基于季节中同一位置的历史数值和历史预测误差构建，其性能显著超过了亚马逊基于学习的非参数预测器DeepNPTS。我们提出了共形专家池（CEP），作为其免训练的后继方法。CEP用一组简单预测器池替代单一的季节朴素预测，根据这些预测器的历史预测误差构建预测分布，并针对被预测的序列对预测器池和误差进行自适应调整。该方法无需训练任何模型，也不跨序列学习任何参数。在包含232个数据集和24,502个预测窗口的CSP基准测试中，CEP在78%的数据集上CRPS优于CSP，在84%的数据集上MSIS更优，在83%的数据集上Winkler评分更优；在典型数据集上，其CRPS降低14%，MSIS降低23%（两者p < 1e-22，配对Wilcoxon检验），且95%预测区间的覆盖率从90.1%提升至92.2%。CEP具有更低的CRPS……

arXiv:2611.21267v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conformal Seasonal Pools (CSP) showed that a forecaster with no training at all, built only from past values at the same point in the season and from past forecast errors, significantly outperformed DeepNPTS, Amazon's learned non-parametric forecaster. We propose Conformal Expert Pools (CEP), a training-free successor. CEP replaces the single seasonal-naive forecast by a pool of simple forecasters, builds its predictive distribution from their past forecast errors, and adapts both the pool and the errors to the series being forecast. No model is trained and no parameter is learned across series. On the CSP benchmark of 232 datasets and 24,502 forecast windows, CEP is better than CSP on 78% of datasets by CRPS, on 84% by MSIS and on 83% by Winkler score; on a typical dataset its CRPS is 14% lower and its MSIS 23% lower (both p < 1e-22, paired Wilcoxon test), and coverage of 95% intervals rises from 90.1% to 92.2%. item.title: 该论文首次将提示构建形式化为自适应数据分析，提出“上下文容量”概念，证明自适应选择示例的上下文学习存在 √(κ/k) 阶的泛化过拟合代价，并给出匹配下界和 PAC-贝叶斯检索规则。
item.description:
选择示例的代价：自适应上下文学习中的上下文过拟合

The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21251

该论文首次将提示构建形式化为自适应数据分析，提出“上下文容量”概念，证明自适应选择示例的上下文学习存在 √(κ/k) 阶的泛化过拟合代价，并给出匹配下界和 PAC-贝叶斯检索规则。

上下文学习通常被分析为提示中的示例在学习器被选定之前就已采样的情形。但在实际部署的系统中并非如此：示例是在看到查询和数据存储之后才被检索、过滤、重排序、编辑并反复测试的。我们通过条件随机核演算将提示构建视为自适应数据分析，从而形式化了这一差距。我们的核心量是上下文容量，即数据存储与最终提示记录之间的互信息或近似最大信息。对于任何冻结的上下文学习器和任何容量为 κ 的自适应上下文流水线，我们证明了阶为 √(κ/k) 的有限样本上下文泛化上界，其中 k 是所选示例的数量，其损失构成所报告的分数。我们证明了匹配的下界，当 log k ≪ κ ≪ k 时其常数是精确的，并推导出两种 PAC-贝叶斯检索规则：一种先（摘要在此处被截断）……

arXiv:2611.21251v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $\kappa$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\sqrt{\kappa/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. item.title: 提出异方差高斯过程Q学习（HGPQ），直接用高斯过程学习Q函数、将贝尔曼目标视为含噪测量，并借助异方差高斯过程自适应调整每个目标的学习率（即卡尔曼增益），从而在自动驾驶实验室等昂贵实验场景中实现样本高效的过程控制学习。
item.description:
面向样本高效实验的异方差高斯过程Q学习

Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning for Sample Efficient Experimentation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21249

提出异方差高斯过程Q学习（HGPQ），直接用高斯过程学习Q函数、将贝尔曼目标视为含噪测量，并借助异方差高斯过程自适应调整每个目标的学习率（即卡尔曼增益），从而在自动驾驶实验室等昂贵实验场景中实现样本高效的过程控制学习。

自动驾驶实验室必须从数十到数百个昂贵实验中学习控制一个过程，这样的样本量对深度强化学习（RL）而言太少了。我们直接用高斯过程（GP）学习Q函数，从而避免了学习系统动力学，并证明高斯过程后验本身就提供了Q学习的学习率。如果将每个贝尔曼目标视为对Q函数的一次含噪测量，那么使均方误差最小的学习率就是卡尔曼增益，而将其应用于每一个观测到的状态转移则等价于高斯过程回归。异方差高斯过程Q学习（HGPQ）利用异方差高斯过程为每个目标设定噪声方差，学习目标值在不同状态和输入下有多不可靠。这样，来自嘈杂运行条件或值函数梯度较大区域的目标，对估计值的更新幅度会小于来自低噪声区域的目标，因此HGPQ能够在数据可靠的地方快速学习。

We learn the Q-function directly with a Gaussian process (GP), which avoids learning the dynamics, and show that the GP posterior supplies the learning rate of Q-learning. If each Bellman target is treated as a noisy measurement of the Q-function, the learning rate that minimises the mean squared error is the Kalman gain, and applying it to every observed transition is equivalent to GP regression. Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning (HGPQ) sets the noise variance of each target with a heteroscedastic GP, which learns how unreliable the targets are across the states and inputs. item.title: 本文证明了适用于自适应选择的任意时刻有效PAC-Bayes证书，使测试时扩展系统在自适应确定采样量、提示词和验证器之后仍能获得统计有效的泛化保证，且同一保证覆盖部署前的全部方案搜索过程。
item.description:

Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21241

本文证明了适用于自适应选择的任意时刻有效PAC-Bayes证书，使测试时扩展系统在自适应确定采样量、提示词和验证器之后仍能获得统计有效的泛化保证，且同一保证覆盖部署前的全部方案搜索过程。

测试时扩展系统通常在反复检查校准集之后，才决定采样多少、使用哪个提示词，以及信任哪个验证器或聚合规则。在这种自适应选择之后，标准的验证误差界便不再有效。我们将测试时扩展方案建模为具有随机成本的随机化预测器，并证明了一个时间一致的PAC-Bayes证书，该证书同时对所有校准时刻、所有关于方案的后验混合分布，以及所有依赖数据的停止规则成立。因此，同一事件既覆盖了部署之前进行的方案搜索，也覆盖了最终报告的固定方案。对于预算和验证器的有限网格，惩罚项是熟悉的 $\log M/n$，在最坏情况下，任何在选择之后有效的证书都无法避免该惩罚项；而非均匀先验和局部化的后验混合分布可以为结构化搜索提供更紧的证书。我们将该结果专门化到自洽性方法并展示

arXiv:2611.21241v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21216

提出MiSTiQ，将格型编码存储与束搜索相结合、并采用微缩放（MX）低精度格式，作为码本向量量化器的即插即用替代方案，在无需大码本的情况下实现KV缓存的极致压缩并保留低精度计算收益。

现代大语言模型（LLM）日益支持更长的上下文并服务更多并发请求，使得序列长度和批处理规模都不断增加。这两种趋势都增大了推理过程中的KV缓存大小和内存流量。KV缓存量化可以降低这些开销，最近的方法使用基于码本的向量量化来实现极低的比特宽度。然而，硬件约束限制了码本的大小，且大多数方法在注意力计算中以更高精度的浮点格式重建缓存，限制了量化带来的计算收益。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了MiSTiQ，它是基于码本的向量量化器的即插即用替代方案，将格型编码存储与微缩放（MX）格式相结合以实现低精度计算。我们将格型量化与束搜索相结合，在无需大码本的情况下于大重建空间中对KV缓存进行编码。为了支持MX计算，我们推导了……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.21216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. item.title: Open-fMIND是首个面向脑基础模型预训练的大规模开放获取fMRI语料库，对322项OpenNeuro研究的45,731次功能扫描进行了统一预处理，并以52种脑区图谱划分出240万条时间序列，解决了fMRI自监督预训练的数据获取瓶颈。
item.description:
Open-fMIND：用于预训练脑基础模型的大规模开放获取fMRI语料库

Open-fMIND: A Large-Scale Open-Access fMRI Corpus for Pretraining Brain Foundation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21215

Open-fMIND是首个面向脑基础模型预训练的大规模开放获取fMRI语料库，对322项OpenNeuro研究的45,731次功能扫描进行了统一预处理，并以52种脑区图谱划分出240万条时间序列，解决了fMRI自监督预训练的数据获取瓶颈。

自监督预训练已经彻底改变了语言和视觉领域，但其在功能磁共振成像上的应用受到数据获取的限制。目前最大的标准化fMRI资源受数据使用协议约束，且被少数几种采集协议所主导；而OpenNeuro上数千个开放许可的数据集则各自规模较小、组织方式各异且未经处理。我们发布了Open-fMIND的首个版本，这是一个经过统一预处理、开放可获取的脑区划分fMRI时间序列语料库，涵盖322项OpenNeuro研究，包含11,379名被试和45,731次功能扫描。每次扫描均使用fMRIPrep进行预处理，并在涵盖14个家族的52种脑区图谱下进行划分，共产生240万条时间序列。这些时间序列以两种形式发布：一种是通过默认流程去噪后的版本，另一种是包含混杂文件协变量的fMRIPrep原始输出版本，同时提供功能连接矩阵、每次扫描的来源信息及元数据。

arXiv:2611.21215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining has transformed language and vision, but its application to functional MRI (fMRI) is constrained by data access. The largest standardized fMRI resources are governed by data use agreements and dominated by a small number of acquisition protocols, while the thousands of openly licensed datasets on OpenNeuro are individually small, heterogeneously organized, and unprocessed. We present the first release of Open-fMIND, a uniformly preprocessed, openly accessible corpus of parcellated fMRI timeseries from 322 OpenNeuro studies, comprising 11,379 subjects and 45,731 functional runs. Each run is preprocessed with fMRIPrep and parcellated under 52 atlases spanning 14 families, yielding a massive 2.4 million timeseries. item.title: 该论文提出一种基于模型自身一致性的监督方法，训练语言模型学会在置信度低时给出更粗粒度但仍保留有用信息的答案，从而在不猜测或拒答的情况下改善正确性与信息量之间的平衡。
item.description:
教语言模型根据自身置信度调整答案粒度

Teaching Language Models to Adapt Answer Granularity to Their Confidence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21211

该论文提出一种基于模型自身一致性的监督方法，训练语言模型学会在置信度低时给出更粗粒度但仍保留有用信息的答案，从而在不猜测或拒答的情况下改善正确性与信息量之间的平衡。

当精确细节不确定时，更粗粒度的答案可以在不进行猜测或放弃作答的情况下保留有用的信息。我们研究了语言模型能否通过基于模型自身状态的监督学习到这种行为，该监督来源于采样响应之间的一致性以及对不同粒度层级答案的识别。我们在时间类和地理类问题以及三个泛化数据集上评估了LFM2.5-1.2B、Ministral 3 3B、Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma 4 31B四个模型。在若干域内设置中，微调提升了正确性与信息量之间的平衡，其效果超过了将基础答案粗化到最佳固定水平的做法。在泛化数据集上，所有四个模型在基础模型置信度较低时比置信度较高时更频繁地给出更粗粒度的答案。当综合考虑正确性与粒度时，三个较小模型的答案在保留关系上也优于基础模型的响应。这些发现证明了置信度相关的粒度适应行为是可学习的。

arXiv:2611.21211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When precise details are uncertain, a coarser answer can retain useful information without guessing or abstaining. We investigate whether language models can learn this behavior through model-conditioned supervision derived from consistency across sampled responses and recognition of answers at different granularity levels. We evaluate LFM2.5-1.2B, Ministral~3~3B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Gemma~4~31B on temporal and geographic questions and three generalization datasets. In several in-domain settings, fine-tuning improves the balance of correctness and informativeness beyond coarsening base answers to the best fixed level. Across generalization datasets, all four models produce coarser answers more often at low than high base-model confidence. The three smaller models' answers are also preferred over base responses on held-out relations when correctness and granularity are considered jointly. item.title: BoBDeLaN通过将增益有界的收缩型递归平衡网络上下文编码器与稳定线性滤波相结合，为深度拉格朗日网络的自适应机器人控制提供了对测量扰动敏感性的有限时域频率加权界保证。
item.description:
BoBDeLaN：面向深度拉格朗日机器人控制的受限带宽上下文自适应

BoBDeLaN: Bounded-Bandwidth Context Adaptation for Deep Lagrangian Robot Control

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21209

BoBDeLaN通过将增益有界的收缩型递归平衡网络上下文编码器与稳定线性滤波相结合，为深度拉格朗日网络的自适应机器人控制提供了对测量扰动敏感性的有限时域频率加权界保证。

基于物理的学习模型为机器人控制提供了结构化的框架，但不确定的负载和未建模的动态限制了其预测精度。上下文感知的深度拉格朗日网络通过从测量历史中推断出的潜在上下文实现自适应调整，同时对每个固定的上下文保持拉格朗日结构。然而，仅凭这种结构并不能约束对测量扰动的敏感性。我们提出了BoBDeLaN，它将收缩的、增益有界的递归平衡网络上下文编码器与稳定的线性滤波相结合，以在不同频率范围内塑造对扰动的敏感性。该架构保证了递归初始化的指数遗忘特性，并给出了有限时域内频率加权的上下文扰动界；在上下文条件化的动力学模型满足Lipschitz连续性假设的前提下，该界可进一步推广至残差力矩预测。我们在模型预测控制实验中评估了一种低通滤波实现（原文摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.21209v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learned physics-based models provide structure for robot control, but uncertain payloads and unmodeled dynamics limit their predictive accuracy. Context-aware Deep Lagrangian Networks enable adaptation through a latent context inferred from measurement histories while retaining Lagrangian structure for each fixed context. However, this structure alone does not constrain sensitivity to measurement disturbances. We introduce BoBDeLaN, which combines a contracting, gain-bounded Recurrent Equilibrium Network context encoder with stable linear filtering to shape disturbance sensitivity across frequencies. item.title: 本文提出了一种预测控制器校准的审计与认证程序，利用残差Gram矩阵确定最小增广秩与最优检验预算，并通过非对称绝对损失对偶和线性规划包络最坏偏移下的可行偏差，从而在环境密度偏移下认证校准有效性并选择操作偏移。
item.description:
面向预测控制的决策相关预测校准

Decision-Relevant Forecast Calibration for Predictive Control

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21203

本文提出了一种预测控制器校准的审计与认证程序，利用残差Gram矩阵确定最小增广秩与最优检验预算，并通过非对称绝对损失对偶和线性规划包络最坏偏移下的可行偏差，从而在环境密度偏移下认证校准有效性并选择操作偏移。

预测控制器的校准证据在操作环境频率发生变化时未必仍然有效。我们针对一类声明的环境密度偏移，在预测器/控制器保持冻结且条件结果规律不变的条件下，开发了一种审计与认证程序。覆盖性要求经校准的检验能够张成密度加权的所选方案敏感度。残差Gram矩阵给出了最小增广秩以及针对未覆盖$L_2$几何结构的最优检验预算。该最优解不一定能在概率可行的条件均值范围内最小化偏差。对于有限环境，非对称绝对损失对偶与方向性线性规划可以包络连续最坏偏移下的可行偏差。将联立矩区间与条件均值域相交，可给出进一步的认证，以及一个用于在验证之后选择操作偏移的线性规划。在一项设计的240环境研究中，两个谱方向移除……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.21203v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Calibration evidence for a predictive controller need not remain valid when operating-context frequencies change. We develop an audit and certification procedure for a declared family of context-density shifts, with a frozen predictor/controller and unchanged conditional outcome law. Coverage requires calibrated tests to span density-weighted selected-plan sensitivities. A residual Gram matrix yields the minimum augmentation rank and an optimal test budget for uncovered $L_2$ geometry. This optimum need not minimize bias over probability-feasible conditional means. For finite contexts, an asymmetric absolute-loss dual and directional linear programs enclose the continuous worst-shift feasible bias. Intersecting simultaneous moment intervals with the conditional-mean domain gives a further certificate and a linear program for selecting an operating shift after validation. item.title: 本文将扩散映射流形学习方法与Y形保形自编码器神经网络相结合，实现了从拉曼光谱数据预测液体浓度，并支持单一模型进行多目标预测，在微凝胶聚合和柠檬酸解离两个数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。
item.description:
利用流形学习与Y形保形自编码器从拉曼光谱测定浓度

Determining Concentration from Raman Spectroscopy with Manifold Learning and Y-shaped Conformal Autoencoders

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21196

本文将扩散映射流形学习方法与Y形保形自编码器神经网络相结合，实现了从拉曼光谱数据预测液体浓度，并支持单一模型进行多目标预测，在微凝胶聚合和柠檬酸解离两个数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。

化学过程监测在化学工程中至关重要，这推动了对先进工艺分析技术（PAT）的需求。在线分析具有显著优势，而拉曼光谱作为一种成熟可靠的分析工具已在众多应用中得到验证，可从中测定多种性质。我们最近[Koronaki等人，AIChEJ 2024]曾提出通过将扩散映射（Diffusion Maps，一种流形学习方法）与Y形保形自编码器神经网络相结合，从拉曼光谱数据测定聚合物颗粒尺寸。在本文中，我们将该工作流程扩展至液体浓度预测，并且允许从同一模型进行多目标预测。我们将这些方法应用于两个包含拉曼测量与浓度测量的数据集：一个来自微凝胶聚合过程，另一个来自柠檬酸解离过程。对于单目标浓度预测（即每次由一个模型确定一个目标变量）的结果……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.21196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monitoring of chemical processes is crucial in chemical engineering, motivating sophisticated process analytical technology (PAT). In-line analytics are advantageous, with Raman spectroscopy being an established and reliable tool in various applications, from which many properties can be determined. We recently [Koronaki et al., AIChEJ 2024] proposed determining polymer particle size from Raman spectroscopic data, by combining Diffusion Maps (a manifold learning method) with a Y-shaped Conformal Autoencoder Neural Network. Herein, we extend this workflow to predict liquid concentrations, allowing also for multiple target predictions from the same model. We apply the methods on two datasets consisting of Raman measurements and concentration measurements: one from microgel polymerization and one from citric acid dissociation. item.title: TRACK将时间序列编码器与小型语言模型结合，通过工具调用实现精确可验证的计算，在设备端生成基于物理原理的结构化故障诊断报告，在15类多负载基准上达到超过95%的准确率并显著超越基线。
item.description:
TRACK：面向电源管理系统故障诊断的工具增强时间序列推理

TRACK: Tool-Augmented Reasoning over Time Series for Fault Diagnosis in Power Management System

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21178

TRACK将时间序列编码器与小型语言模型结合，通过工具调用实现精确可验证的计算，在设备端生成基于物理原理的结构化故障诊断报告，在15类多负载基准上达到超过95%的准确率并显著超越基线。

运行多个负载的电源管理系统中的故障诊断目前依赖专家手动检查电流和电压波形，这种方式难以在大量已部署设备上扩展。我们提出了TRACK，它将时间序列编码器与小型语言模型（SLM）相结合，生成结构化、基于物理原理的诊断报告，并通过调用工具进行精确、可验证的计算。该系统在设备端运行，将专有传感器数据保留在本地，同时避免了昂贵的API调用费用。我们引入了一个基于评分细则的评估框架，通过逐项评判结构、信号保真度、物理推理、诊断和可操作性等准则来评估这些报告。在一个15类多负载模拟基准上，TRACK实现了超过95%的故障类别准确率，并能泛化到分布外故障，而最好的编码器探测基线仅达到58%的准确率。

arXiv:2611.21178v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. It operates on-device, keeping proprietary sensor data local and avoiding expensive API calls. We introduce a rubric-based framework that evaluates these reports by scoring structure, signal fidelity, physics reasoning, diagnosis, and actionability through per-criterion verdicts. On a 15-class multi-load simulated benchmark, TRACK achieves over 95% fault-category accuracy and generalizes to out-of-distribution faults, whereas the best encoder-probing baseline reaches only 58% accuracy.

item.title: 该论文提出 RAGE 方法，将源保真度控制建模为随机最优控制问题并推导出残差门控原理——以随局部残差幅值指数衰减的增益将潜变量拉回源图像，从而无需掩码或注意力图即可抑制非编辑区域的意外漂移，同时保留有语义意义的编辑。
item.description:
RAGE：面向基于流图像编辑的残差自适应门控

RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21177

该论文提出 RAGE 方法，将源保真度控制建模为随机最优控制问题并推导出残差门控原理——以随局部残差幅值指数衰减的增益将潜变量拉回源图像，从而无需掩码或注意力图即可抑制非编辑区域的意外漂移，同时保留有语义意义的编辑。

近期无需反演的基于流的图像编辑方法通过微分速度场将源图像向目标图像演化。我们观察到，该速度场并未显式考虑哪些区域应当被保留，导致非编辑区域出现意外的漂移。为解决这一问题，我们将源保真度控制形式化为一个随机最优控制问题，在编辑轨迹上对编辑残差施加选择性保真项。求解该问题并对其解进行近似，得到了残差门控原理：每个潜在分量以一个随局部残差幅值指数衰减的增益被拉回源图像，从而抑制微小偏差，同时使大的、具有语义意义的编辑畅通无阻地通过。所提出的 RAGE 方法在每个采样步骤中仅需一次轻量级的门控插值，无需掩码估计和注意力图。

arXiv:2611.21177v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent inversion-free, flow-based image editing methods evolve the source image toward the target via a differential velocity field. We observe that this velocity field does not explicitly account for which regions should be preserved, leading to unintended drift in non-editing regions. To address this, we formulate source fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem in which a selective fidelity term on the editing residual is enforced along the editing trajectory. Solving this problem and approximating its solution yields the Residual Gating Principle: each latent component is pulled back toward the source with a gain that decays exponentially with the local residual magnitude, so that small deviations are suppressed while large, semantically meaningful edits pass through unimpeded. item.title: 该论文提出compass框架，首次借助结合transformer架构的条件分数扩散模型，对具有难解似然的银河化学演化模型实现了摊销式联合贝叶斯模型比较与参数推断。
item.description:
银河系之指南针（COMPASS）：银河化学演化中核合成产额集合的联合比较与参数推断

A COMPASS to the Galaxy: Joint nucleosynthetic yield set comparison and parameter inference in Galactic chemical evolution

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21175

该论文提出compass框架，首次借助结合transformer架构的条件分数扩散模型，对具有难解似然的银河化学演化模型实现了摊销式联合贝叶斯模型比较与参数推断。

银河化学演化（GCE）模型将恒星核合成与观测到的元素丰度模式联系起来，但对其结果的解读需要同时进行参数推断以及在相互竞争的恒星产额假说之间进行比较。由于似然函数难以解析处理，加之数据集复杂度不断增长，这一任务仍然充满挑战。利用compass这一新颖的基于模拟的推断框架，我们首次在统一的架构中，对具有难解似然函数的GCE模型实现了摊销式联合贝叶斯模型比较与参数推断。Compass采用结合transformer架构的条件分数扩散模型，直接从前向模拟中学习后验分布与似然函数，从而实现高效推断，并能基于似然对相互竞争的核合成产额集合进行排序。在受控测试中，compass能够识别出生成数据的产额集合，并以相当的精度恢复出真实参数。

arXiv:2611.21175v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Galactic Chemical Evolution (GCE) models connect stellar nucleosynthesis to observed abundance patterns, but their interpretation requires simultaneous parameter inference and comparison between competing stellar yield prescriptions. This remains challenging due to intractable likelihoods and growing dataset complexity. Using compass, a novel simulation-based inference framework, we perform, for the first time, amortized joint Bayesian model comparison and parameter inference for GCE models with intractable likelihoods within a unified architecture. Compass employs a conditional score-based diffusion model with a transformer architecture to learn both the posterior and likelihood directly from forward simulations, enabling efficient inference and likelihood-based ranking of competing nucleosynthetic yield sets. In controlled tests, compass identifies the generating yield set and recovers ground-truth parameters with accuracy comparable

When Feature Representation Changes Local Explanations: A Controlled Comparison of SHAP and LIME under Numerical Discretization

局部特征归因是在由上游数据工程步骤所选定的特征表示上计算的，然而它们却被解读为关于底层物理量的陈述。我们探讨当分类器保持固定时，对一个连续特征进行离散化会如何改变局部KernelSHAP和LIME的解释，以及这两种解释器是否会有不同的响应。我们在UCI Adult数据集上训练一个随机森林并将其冻结；在模型接收数据之前，将age特征折叠为等宽或分位数分箱的代表值（k ∈ {3, 5, 10}），并在多种随机种子下的每种条件中对相同的120个留出实例进行解释。我们从分析上和数值上证明，对于KernelSHAP，这恰好等价于在量化实例上、以量化背景解释未改变的模型，因此这种比较是两个有效输入之间的比较，而非纯粹的解释器效应；对于LIME则不存在这种等价性。每次归因变化都与……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.21159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local feature attributions are computed over a feature representation chosen by an upstream data-engineering step, yet they are read as statements about the underlying quantity. We ask how discretizing one continuous feature changes local KernelSHAP and LIME explanations when the classifier is held fixed, and whether the two explainers respond differently. A random forest is trained on UCI Adult and frozen; age is collapsed onto equi-width or quantile bin representatives (k in {3,5,10}) before the model receives it, and the same 120 held-out instances are explained in every condition across multiple seeds. We show analytically and numerically that for KernelSHAP this is exactly equivalent to explaining the unchanged model at the quantized instance against a quantized background, so the comparison is between two effective inputs rather than a pure explainer effect; for LIME no such equivalence holds. item.title: 提出了一种价格上限感知的LightGBM预测框架，通过分类头估计触及价格上限的概率、回归头在对数空间预测未封顶价格，并结合概率融合与九分位数不确定性估计，显著提升了印度绿色日前市场电价预测精度。
item.description:
面向绿色日前电价预测的价格上限感知Boosting方法

Cap-Aware Boosting for Green Day-Ahead Electricity Price Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21149

提出了一种价格上限感知的LightGBM预测框架，通过分类头估计触及价格上限的概率、回归头在对数空间预测未封顶价格，并结合概率融合与九分位数不确定性估计，显著提升了印度绿色日前市场电价预测精度。

对绿色日前市场（GDAM）电价的准确预测对印度电力行业的市场参与者至关重要。我们提出了一种基于LightGBM的印度能源交易所GDAM价格预测框架，该市场每天以96个15分钟时段出清。所提出的系统通过将触及价格上限的事件与正常市场条件分离，显式地建模价格上限行为。其中一个分类头估计触及监管价格上限（10,000卢比/兆瓦时）的概率，另一个回归头在对数空间中预测未触及上限的价格。最终预测通过对这两个组成部分进行概率融合获得，并附带九个分位数预测用于不确定性估计。在2026年1月1日至9月14日的257个交易日的评估中，该模型实现了397.9卢比/兆瓦时的平均绝对误差（MAE）和9.57%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），显著优于Chronos-2基线模型。

arXiv:2611.21149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate forecasting of Green Day-Ahead Market (GDAM) electricity prices is essential for market participants in the Indian power sector. We present a LightGBM-based forecasting framework for Indian Energy Exchange GDAM prices, which clear in 96 fifteen-minute intervals per day. The proposed system explicitly models price-cap behavior by separating capped-price events from normal market conditions. A classification head estimates the probability of the regulatory price cap (Rs 10,000/MWh), while a regression head predicts uncapped prices in logarithmic space. Final forecasts are obtained through probabilistic blending of these components and are accompanied by nine quantile forecasts for uncertainty estimation. Evaluated on 257 trading days between 1 January and 14 September 2026, the model achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 397.9 Rs/MWh and a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 9.57%, substantially outperforming a Chronos-2 ba

item.title: 首次研究了Transformer嗓音障碍检测中跨20种智能手机麦克风的麦克风不匹配问题，并提出受Barlow Twins启发的模块学习麦克风不变表示，将匹配与不匹配条件间的性能差距缩小多达62%。
item.description:
面向基于Transformer的嗓音障碍检测的麦克风不变语音表示研究

Towards Microphone-Invariant Speech Representations for Transformer-Based Voice Disorder Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21140

首次研究了Transformer嗓音障碍检测中跨20种智能手机麦克风的麦克风不匹配问题，并提出受Barlow Twins启发的模块学习麦克风不变表示，将匹配与不匹配条件间的性能差距缩小多达62%。

从语音中自动检测嗓音障碍为早期诊断和疾病的持续监测提供了巨大潜力。虽然基于预训练Transformer的模型提升了检测性能，但它们对麦克风变化的鲁棒性仍未得到充分探索，尤其是针对消费级设备。据我们所知，本研究首次在基于Transformer的二分类嗓音障碍检测中研究了跨20种智能手机麦克风的麦克风不匹配问题。虽然大多数不匹配的麦克风条件会导致中等程度的性能下降，但最坏情况会使非加权平均召回率降低多达12.53个百分点。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一个受Barlow Twins启发的模块来学习麦克风不变的语音表示。我们的方法将匹配与不匹配条件之间的性能差距缩小了多达62%，同时在匹配条件下保持了相当的检测性能。

arXiv:2611.21140v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic voice disorder detection from speech offers strong potential for early diagnosis and continuous disease monitoring. While models based on pre-trained transformers have improved detection performance, their robustness to microphone variation remains underexplored, particularly for consumer-grade devices. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first study of microphone mismatch in transformer-based binary voice disorder detection across 20 smartphone microphones. While most mismatched microphone conditions cause moderate performance degradation, the worst-case condition reduces unweighted average recall by up to 12.53 percentage points. To address this, we introduce a Barlow Twins-inspired module to learn microphone-invariant representations. item.title: 研究发现高维情况下扩散过程的闭式解析解几乎退化为线性变换，因此无需预训练、直接利用闭式耦合进行少步生成的方法在实践中不可行。
item.description:
少步生成中闭式耦合的局限性

The Limits of Closed-Form Couplings for Few-Step Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21119

研究发现高维情况下扩散过程的闭式解析解几乎退化为线性变换，因此无需预训练、直接利用闭式耦合进行少步生成的方法在实践中不可行。

基于流模型的少步生成器需要复杂的技术方案，例如预训练的流模型或一致性损失。尽管整流流因其在少步采样中的成功而广受欢迎，但其代价是需要一个预训练模型，并且需要为每个数据集采样大量的耦合。然而，对于有限数据集和高斯概率路径，经验分布的概率流向量场存在闭式解，因此人们可以将该场作为教师，完全跳过预训练。我们证明，令人惊讶的是，这种方法对于具有实际意义的问题是不可能实现的。特别地，高维空间中扩散过程的解析解几乎变成一个线性变换。积分的结果返回的是初始化时抽取的噪声向量，加上一个在经验上表现为数据点微弱副本的漂移项，且该漂移几乎与噪声无关。因此该耦合……

arXiv:2611.21119v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Few-step generators via flow models require complicated technical solutions such as a pretrained flow model or a consistency loss. While rectified flows have gained popularity for their success in few-step sampling, they pay a cost of needing a pre-trained model and sampling a large number of couplings per dataset. Yet for a finite dataset and a Gaussian probability path, the probability-flow vector field of the empirical distribution is available in closed form, so one could use this field as the teacher and skip pretraining altogether. We demonstrate that, surprisingly, this approach is impossible for problems of practical relevance. In particular, the analytic solution of the diffusion process in high dimensions becomes almost a linear transformation. item.title: 机器学习原子间势的冻结嵌入不仅能够解码出训练目标之外的材料性质，其最优解码深度还呈现出随物理尺度有序排列的规律。
item.description:
冻结原子间势嵌入中的训练外性质可被解码并按物理尺度排序

Out-of-training properties in frozen interatomic potential embeddings are decodable and ordered by physical scale

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21116

机器学习原子间势的冻结嵌入不仅能够解码出训练目标之外的材料性质，其最优解码深度还呈现出随物理尺度有序排列的规律。

机器学习原子间势（MLIP）通常在能量、力和应力上进行训练，但其冻结的表征却能够预测其他材料性质。我们在154,875个Materials Project晶体上，跨越不同层、读取方式和等变通道，探测了ORB-v3和UMA-S两种模型对九种性质的预测能力。两个模型在所有目标上都优于仅基于化学成分的描述符，其中包括五种超出其训练目标的性质；以物理单位表示的误差有助于评估其在潜在高通量筛选应用中的价值。最优解码深度随性质不同而变化，这与物理尺度的排序规律一致。随机权重对照实验揭示了预训练带来的收益强烈依赖于具体性质。UMA-S的旋转不变角通道改善了晶系分类性能，而其完整张量所获得的更高分数在旋转下消失；匹配模型的对照实验未能将等变性单独确认为解释原因。不同探测方法之间的准确度有所差异，但最近邻预测通常……

arXiv:2611.21116v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are trained on energies, forces and stresses, yet their frozen representations can predict other materials properties. We probe ORB-v3 and UMA-S across layers, read-outs and equivariant channels for nine properties of 154,875 Materials Project crystals. UMA-S's rotation-invariant angular channels improve crystal-system classification, while higher scores from its full tensor disappear under rotation; matched-model controls do not isolate equivariance as the explanation. item.title: 本文扩展了富有表现力的einspace搜索空间，提出首个能够从基础操作构建并搜索自回归序列模型的新颖搜索空间einspaceAR，突破了以往搜索空间仅适用于图像分类且对架构结构施加强归纳偏置的限制。
item.description:
从基础操作中搜索自回归神经架构

Searching for Autoregressive Neural Architectures from Fundamental Operations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21111

本文扩展了富有表现力的einspace搜索空间，提出首个能够从基础操作构建并搜索自回归序列模型的新颖搜索空间einspaceAR，突破了以往搜索空间仅适用于图像分类且对架构结构施加强归纳偏置的限制。

富有表现力的神经架构搜索（NAS）搜索空间是非常理想的，因为它们不会将潜在架构的空间限制在已有架构的范围之内。然而，很少有搜索空间具有足够的表现力来表示广泛的架构家族，且那些具有表现力的搜索空间主要集中于图像分类问题。自回归序列建模任务在现代机器学习中已无处不在，但目前没有任何现有搜索空间支持从基础操作出发构建序列模型并对其进行搜索，而是对潜在架构的结构施加了强烈的归纳偏置。本工作描述了如何扩展富有表现力的einspace搜索空间，从而产生一个能够使用基础操作表示自回归模型的搜索空间。我们进行了一系列实验，表明新颖的einspaceAR搜索空间可以找到性能强大的自回归序列模型。

arXiv:2611.21111v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Expressive Neural Architecture Search (NAS) search spaces are desirable as they do not restrict the space of potential architectures to what is already established. However, few search spaces are expressive enough to represent a broad range of architecture families, and those that are have focused primarily on image classification problems. The task of autoregressive sequence modelling has become ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but no existing search space supports the construction of and search over sequence models from fundamental operations, instead imposing strong inductive biases on the structure of potential architectures. This work describes how the expressive einspace search space can be extended to yield a search space capable of representing autoregressive models using fundamental operations. We perform a series of experiments showing that the novel einspaceAR search space can find capable autoregressive sequence model

item.title: 该论文提出推理等价与商编码框架，证明按具体性排序的语义论断族的“精确推理前沿”是生成全部有效结论的唯一极小反链，并据此构造出在保留所有有效推理结论前提下区分最少的规范商编码。
item.description:
推理等价与商编码

Inference Equivalence and Quotient Coding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21096

该论文提出推理等价与商编码框架，证明按具体性排序的语义论断族的“精确推理前沿”是生成全部有效结论的唯一极小反链，并据此构造出在保留所有有效推理结论前提下区分最少的规范商编码。

不完整的观测可以允许多种物理解释，而不致使每一项任务结论都变得含糊。恢复所有兼容的场景往往并无必要，而不加区分的压缩则可能改变哪些论断是有依据的。我们提出的问题是：为了保留某一指定任务的全部有效结论，在观测兼容的解释集合之间必须保留哪些区分。我们首先将推理有效性定义为在所有物理兼容状态下均为真，并在一个封闭性条件下，通过其到物理可实现的反驳性测量的距离来加以刻画。对于一个按具体性排序的有限语义论断族，精确推理前沿构成生成所有有效论断的唯一极小反链。随后我们定义兼容性集合之间的推理等价，并由它们的前沿构造出一个规范的商编码。在允许精确推理解码的确定性编码之中，该编码诱导出最粗的编码。

arXiv:2611.21096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Incomplete observations can admit multiple physical interpretations without making every task conclusion ambiguous. Recovering all compatible scenes is often unnecessary, whereas indiscriminate compression may change which claims are justified. We ask which distinctions among observation-compatible interpretation sets must be retained to preserve every valid conclusion of a specified task. We first define inference validity as truth across all physically compatible states and characterize it, under a closedness condition, by distances to physically realizable falsifying measurements. For a finite semantic claim family ordered by specificity, the Exact Inference Frontier forms the unique minimal antichain generating all valid claims. We then define inference equivalence between compatibility sets and construct a canonical quotient code from their frontiers. item.title: SemiNovo提出了一种半监督框架，通过联合学习已鉴定谱图与大规模未标记谱图（DarkSpec语料库），克服了传统从头肽段测序仅依赖数据库搜索鉴定结果训练所导致的分布不匹配问题，从而提升肽段鉴定性能。
item.description:
SemiNovo：超越搜索鉴定谱图学习的从头肽段测序方法

SemiNovo: Learning Beyond Search-Identified Spectra for De Novo Peptide Sequencing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21079

SemiNovo提出了一种半监督框架，通过联合学习已鉴定谱图与大规模未标记谱图（DarkSpec语料库），克服了传统从头肽段测序仅依赖数据库搜索鉴定结果训练所导致的分布不匹配问题，从而提升肽段鉴定性能。

敏感的肽段鉴定是蛋白质表征与新蛋白质发现的基础，而基于串联质谱的从头肽段测序（DNPS）为此提供了一种重要的不依赖数据库的方法。尽管深度学习已极大推动了从头测序技术的发展，现有模型主要依赖通过数据库搜索获得的高置信度肽段-谱图匹配进行训练。这种以搜索结果为条件的监督方式排除了大量未被鉴定的谱图，导致经过选择性标注的训练数据与推理时遇到的完整谱图数据流之间存在分布不匹配，从而限制了肽段鉴定的性能。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了SemiNovo，一个能够从已鉴定谱图和未标记谱图中联合学习的半监督框架。SemiNovo首先构建了DarkSpec，一个从（原文截断）收集的大规模、经过质量控制筛选的未标记谱图语料库，

arXiv:2611.21079v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sensitive peptide identification is fundamental to protein characterization and novel protein discovery, for which de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) from tandem mass spectra provides an important database-independent approach. Although deep learning has substantially advanced de novo sequencing, existing models are predominantly trained on high-confidence peptide-spectrum matches obtained through database search. This search-conditioned supervision excludes a large fraction of unidentified spectra, creating a distribution mismatch between the selectively labeled training data and the complete spectrum stream encountered at inference time, thereby limiting peptide identification performance. item.title: 本文提出一种用学习到的最优干预剩余代价近似实现的非短视CBF安全滤波器，在保持与传统CBF滤波器相同可行性和前向不变性的前提下减少累积干预努力，并给出无需最优值函数或近似误差界的轨迹级性能证书。
item.description:
基于学习干预剩余代价的非短视安全滤波

Non-Myopic Safety Filtering with Learned Intervention Cost-to-Go

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21036

本文提出一种用学习到的最优干预剩余代价近似实现的非短视CBF安全滤波器，在保持与传统CBF滤波器相同可行性和前向不变性的前提下减少累积干预努力，并给出无需最优值函数或近似误差界的轨迹级性能证书。

控制屏障函数（CBF）安全滤波器最小化与名义控制指令的瞬时偏差，但一系列逐点最小化的干预未必能最小化累积干预努力。本文提出了一种离散时间的非短视安全滤波器，它使用在CBF可行策略上对最优干预剩余代价的学习近似。该近似通过一个松弛的贝尔曼残差约束引入，而原始的屏障条件仍保持为硬约束。该滤波器的可行性与传统CBF滤波器等价，并且在所述假设下，前向不变性仍然独立于近似精度。我们推导了一个轨迹级的性能证书，该证书既不需要最优值函数，也不需要近似误差界。在额外的近似和时域假设下，次优性界中包含一个显式的端点近似误差项以及累积（摘要截断）

arXiv:2611.21036v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters minimize instantaneous deviation from a nominal control command, but a sequence of pointwise-minimal interventions need not minimize cumulative intervention effort. Feasibility is equivalent to that of the conventional CBF filter, and forward invariance remains independent of approximation accuracy under the stated assumptions. 在本工作中，我们研究了同策略蒸馏（OPD）在将智能体编程能力从大型教师模型迁移到较小学生模型中的应用。以往的工作主要集中在推理和短时程智能体任务上。我们提出了 SWE-OPD，这是一项针对软件工程的最小化 OPD 研究，其中学生模型与可执行的代码仓库进行交互，而教师模型则对学生模型所访问的轨迹前缀进行监督。在三个教师-学生模型对、两种训练数据来源和三个 SWE 基准测试上，我们发现同策略监督能够有效迁移编程能力：来自 Qwen3.6-27B 的监督使 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Pro 上的解决率从 35.9% 提升至 39.4%。此外，刷新轨迹并非严格必需，因为使用缓存教师评分的离线变体在基准相关的精度水平下仍能超越学生模型基线，同时将端到端 GPU 小时数削减 59.4%–72.6%，并将峰值 GPU 占用减半。此外，w（原文摘要在此处截断）

We present SWE-OPD, a minimal OPD study for software engineering, where the student interacts with executable repositories and the teacher supervises the prefixes visited by the student. 一种面向时间离散化滑坡运动建模的物理约束模拟器

A physics-constrained emulator for time-discretised landslide runout modelling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21015

该研究提出一种以质量守恒和动能损失作为物理约束的神经网络模拟器，能够以时间离散化、自回归的方式高保真且高效地模拟滑坡运动全过程，从而克服了全物理模型计算成本过高、难以支撑大规模参数扫描的问题。

滑坡数值模拟通常被用于预测滑坡的影响区域。基于完整物理过程的模型能够提供准确的预测，但其高昂的计算成本使其难以用于大规模参数扫描。为了在这类场景下实现高效建模，我们开发了一种物理约束神经网络，以时间离散化的方式模拟完整的滑坡运动过程。该模拟器基于超过20万个样本进行训练，每个样本由给定数字高程模型（DEM）上固定时间间隔的一对滑坡厚度和速度场组成。为约束模型的物理一致性，我们基于质量守恒和系统动能损失定义了物理损失函数。该模型在整个测试数据集上表现出高保真度，单步预测中厚度和速度的均方根误差分别约为0.06米和0.11米/秒。在自回归滚动预测中，这些误差仅温和增长至约0.21米……

arXiv:2611.21015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Numerical simulations of landslides are commonly used to forecast impact areas. Full physics-based models provide accurate predictions, but their computational expense can preclude their use for large parameter sweeps. To achieve efficient modelling for such cases, we developed a physics-constrained neural network to emulate full landslide runout in a time-discretised manner. This emulator is trained on over 200,000 samples, each consisting of a pair of landslide thicknesses and velocities on a given DEM with a fixed time interval. To constrain the model's physical consistency, we define physics-based loss functions based on mass conservation and the system's kinetic energy loss. The model demonstrates high fidelity across the test dataset, achieving root mean square errors of approximately 0.06 m for thickness and 0.11 m/s for velocity in single-step predictions. item.title: 本文利用输入凸神经网络与Polyak-Łojasiewicz网络的结构特性，在构造层面保证控制李雅普诺夫函数的正定性，并结合混合整数规划形式化验证与迭代吸引域扩展方法，实现了非线性离散时间系统中稳定控制器与CLF的联合学习与认证。
item.description:
基于结构化神经控制李雅普诺夫函数的稳定控制器学习与验证

Learning and Verifying Stabilizing Controllers with Structured Neural Control Lyapunov Functions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21009

本文利用输入凸神经网络与Polyak-Łojasiewicz网络的结构特性，在构造层面保证控制李雅普诺夫函数的正定性，并结合混合整数规划形式化验证与迭代吸引域扩展方法，实现了非线性离散时间系统中稳定控制器与CLF的联合学习与认证。

本研究针对非线性离散时间系统，探索了神经控制器与控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）的联合学习。我们利用输入凸神经网络和Polyak-Łojasiewicz网络的结构特性，通过构造方式保证CLF候选函数的正定性，从而减少了需要形式化验证的条件。我们开发了一个混合整数规划框架来形式化验证剩余的稳定性条件，并引入了一种迭代式的吸引域（ROA）扩展方法，无需重新训练即可扩大经认证的吸引域。在倒立摆和路径跟踪系统上的实验展示了结构化神经CLF（特别是PLNets）的优势，并说明了其结构界如何影响认证区域的几何形状。我们的代码已开源于：https://github.com/JLedesMart/Structured-Neural-Control-Lyapunov-Functions。

arXiv:2611.21009v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work investigates the joint learning of neural controllers and control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) for nonlinear discrete-time systems. We exploit the structural properties of Input Convex Neural Networks and Polyak-{\L}ojasiewicz Networks to guarantee positive definiteness of CLF candidates by construction, reducing the conditions requiring formal verification. We develop a mixed-integer programming framework to formally verify the remaining stability conditions and introduce an iterative region of attraction (ROA) expansion procedure to enlarge the certified ROA without retraining. Experiments on an inverted pendulum and a path-tracking system demonstrate the advantages of structured neural CLFs, particularly PLNets, and illustrate how their structural bounds influence the geometry of the certified regions. Our code is available at: https://github.com/JLedesMart/Structured-Neural-Control-Lyapunov-Functions.

多输出树集成通过决策路径预测多个二元标签，而这些路径在很大程度上被各标签所共享，然而常用于解释此类模型的归因方法往往将每个输出孤立地对待。我们提出了多汇点决策谓词图，它在决策谓词图的基础上为每个标签增设一个汇点：每个叶子节点将其在该标签上的袋内正样本计数贡献给该标签对应的汇点。在这一表示之上，我们定义了共享谓词流，即某个标签的决策质量中流经对该标签对双方均活跃的条件所占的比例，并给出图的收缩视图，其中标签特定的提升度能够表明某个共享条件是同时提升两个标签的概率，还是以牺牲其中一个标签为代价来提升另一个。受控实验表明，SPF 捕捉的是共享的决策条件，而不仅仅是特征层面的重叠。在九个多标签基准数据集上，原生的多输出森林……

在结构化贝叶斯模型中，一个较大的潜变量块在给定较小参数集的条件下通常服从高斯分布，然而通用的推断方法往往需要在预热阶段重新学习这一几何结构。我们研究如何利用这一结构来构建用于后验推断的传输映射。条件均值和精度矩阵确定了精确的仿射映射，包括对称Brenier映射和三角形Knothe-Rosenblatt映射，它们将一个标准正态块与其余的非高斯核心分离开来。KL散度和相对Fisher目标随之约化为该核心上的目标函数。我们提出了CONGA——一个编译器，它识别候选的高斯块，并根据其结构与计算成本选择时间型、谱型或稀疏型实现方式。边缘化需要从模型本身建立恒等式；仅有数值证据时，只允许进行保持目标分布的变量替换，而检查失败时模型保持不变。在Stock-Watson宏观数据（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.20995v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In structured Bayesian models, a large latent block is often Gaussian conditional on a smaller set of parameters, yet generic inference methods relearn this geometry during warmup. We study how this structure can be used to construct transports for posterior inference. The conditional mean and precision determine exact affine maps, including symmetric Brenier and triangular Knothe-Rosenblatt maps, that separate a standard normal block from the remaining non-Gaussian core. KL and relative Fisher objectives then reduce to objectives on this core. We introduce CONGA, a compiler that identifies candidate Gaussian blocks and selects a temporal, spectral, or sparse implementation according to their structure and computational cost. Marginalization requires an identity established from the model; numerical evidence alone permits only a target-preserving change of variables, and a failed check leaves the model unchanged. 该论文提出FH-Sampling方法，通过构建超图捕捉样本间高阶关系并进行频率感知的过采样，在保持频谱保真度的同时缓解不平衡时间序列分类中的多数类偏向问题。

不平衡时间序列数据广泛存在于各类应用中，例如医学诊断。当在不平衡数据上进行训练时，分类器往往表现出对多数类的偏向，导致难以准确识别少数类实例，尽管少数类至关重要。采样技术已被证明能够有效地重新平衡不平衡数据。然而，现有的基于插值的过采样方法通常依赖成对插值，限制了其捕捉样本间高阶关系的能力，并且其固有的平滑效应往往会抑制高频成分，损害频谱保真度。因此，我们提出了一种面向不平衡时间序列分类的频率感知超图驱动过采样方法（FH-Sampling）。在FH-Sampling中，首先在原始时间序列空间中构建超图以捕捉复杂的高阶样本间关系，并且采样比例……

arXiv:2611.20991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Imbalanced time-series data appears commonly in diverse applications, such as medical diagnosis. When trained on imbalanced data, classifiers tend to exhibit a bias toward the majority class, making it difficult to identify minority-class instances accurately, despite their critical importance. Sampling techniques have proven effective in rebalancing imbalanced data. However, existing interpolation-based oversampling methods typically rely on pairwise interpolation, limiting their ability to capture high-order inter-sample relationships, and their inherent smoothing effects tend to suppress high-frequency components, compromising spectral fidelity. Therefore, we propose a Frequency-aware Hypergraph-driven Oversampling method (FH-Sampling) for imbalanced time-series classification. item.title: 该论文提出两种无需重新训练即可跨系综迁移的单层神经网络预条件器（规范协变平行输运卷积网络与类CNN网络），显著减少格点QCD中Wilson-Clover传播子求逆的GCR迭代次数，且在大体积系综上成本优势更为突出。
item.description:
用于Wilson-Clover传播子求逆的可迁移神经网络预条件器

Transferable neural-network preconditioners for Wilson--Clover propagator inversions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20990

该论文提出两种无需重新训练即可跨系综迁移的单层神经网络预条件器（规范协变平行输运卷积网络与类CNN网络），显著减少格点QCD中Wilson-Clover传播子求逆的GCR迭代次数，且在大体积系综上成本优势更为突出。

我们研究了两种单层神经网络架构，用于加速实际使用的格点系综上的四维Wilson-Clover传播子求逆；两者均可直接迁移而无需重新训练。第一种是规范协变的平行输运卷积（PTC）网络，可直接减少广义共轭残差（GCR）求解器的迭代次数。第二种是类似CNN的网络，与受多重网格启发的算法结合使用。这两种方法还可以结合，以进一步减少GCR迭代次数。PTC在无需重新训练的情况下，可在不同格点体积、格点间距和π介子质量的系综之间迁移，同时保持相当的加速效果；而类CNN网络可以直接从小体积系综迁移到大体积系综，并带来强劲的加速效果。综合考虑基组构建和求解两方面成本的比较表明，所提出的方案在大体积系综上比在小体积系综上更具优势。

arXiv:2611.20990v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate two single--layer neural-network architectures for accelerating four-dimensional Wilson--Clover propagator inversions on lattice ensembles in practical use; both transfer directly without retraining. The second is a CNN-like network used together with a multigrid-inspired algorithm. The two approaches can be combined to further reduce GCR iterations. PTC transfers without retraining across lattice volumes, lattice spacings, and pion masses while maintaining comparable acceleration, whereas the CNN-like network transfers directly from small- to large-volume ensembles with strong acceleration. 家具装配规划需要从单个零件和目标图示中推断出子装配层级结构。现有的基于栅格的方法未能显式利用SVG图纸中的几何和结构信息。我们提出了VASR，这是一个将专用SVG编码器提取的特征与预训练视觉语言模型的视觉表示相融合的框架，用于预测装配层级结构。为避免对参考装配树的有效替代方案进行惩罚，我们提出了修复感知层级策略优化（RHPO），并采用保持层级的等价奖励。RHPO进一步利用修复成本反馈，在等价感知奖励相近的候选方案中，倾向于选择下游修正成本更低的决策。VASR在所有被评估的方法中取得了最高的Equivalent-Hard F1分数，在基于IKEA的测试集上比GPT6-Astra高出17.69个百分点，同时在i（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.20984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Furniture assembly planning requires inferring subassembly hierarchies from individual parts and a target illustration. Existing raster-based methods do not explicitly exploit the geometric and structural information in SVG drawings. We introduce VASR, a framework that fuses features from a dedicated SVG encoder with visual representations from a pretrained vision-language model to predict assembly hierarchies. https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20983

GRACE提出一种面向生产的并行Best-of-N多智能体流水线，不依赖答案投票，而是通过两两锦标赛预筛与领域专用护栏评判实际执行的代码产物，在无可辩护答案时敢于整体拒绝，从而更可靠地回答数据框上的封闭式问题。

LLM智能体通过编写并执行Python代码来回答关于表格数据框的封闭式问题，几乎总是采用单次生成模式：一种解释、一个脚本、一个结果，不经比较便直接采纳。少数能产生多个候选答案的流水线则通过答案一致性投票来协调，这要求存在单一可比较的标量答案，并且总会返回一个答案——即使所有候选都是错误的。我们提出GRACE（Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble，生成式、排序式、自适应代码集成），一个面向生产的流水线，专门针对数据框代码执行并行Best-of-N选择。N个智能体在严格且机器可校验的输出契约下并发运行，并通过角色提示、每次重试的轮换机制以及双区间温度调度实现多样化。GRACE不采用投票，而是评判实际执行的产物：一个两两对决的锦标赛先对候选池进行预筛，随后由领域专用护栏要么选出最佳候选，要么在没有任何可辩护候选时拒绝整个候选池。

arXiv:2611.20983v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents answer closed-form questions over a tabular dataframe by writing and executing Python, almost always as a single rollout: one interpretation, one script, one result, accepted without comparison. The few pipelines that produce several candidates reconcile them by answer-agreement voting, which needs a single comparable scalar and always returns one, even when every candidate is wrong. We present GRACE (Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble), a production-oriented pipeline that instead runs parallel best-of-N selection specialised to dataframe code. N agents run concurrently under a strict, machine-checkable output contract, diversified by persona hints, per-retry rotation, and a two-regime temperature schedule. Rather than vote, GRACE judges the executed artefacts: a pairwise tournament pre-filters the pool and a domain-specialised guardrail either selects the best candidate or, when none is defensible, rejects the whole p

item.title: 该论文提出OTISv2，通过在特征空间引入自蒸馏损失和KoLeo正则化器来抑制自监督时间序列编码器的特征坍缩问题，使编码器能够从7.1M参数单调扩展至116M参数并保持性能提升。
item.description:
打破自监督时间序列编码器中的特征坍缩

Breaking feature collapse in self-supervised time series encoders

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20981

该论文提出OTISv2，通过在特征空间引入自蒸馏损失和KoLeo正则化器来抑制自监督时间序列编码器的特征坍缩问题，使编码器能够从7.1M参数单调扩展至116M参数并保持性能提升。

通用时间序列编码器有望提供一个能在不同任务和领域间泛化的单一骨干网络；然而，它们目前无法有效扩展规模。我们将这一问题追溯到一个关键的失败点：在主流的掩载数据建模监督下，编码器的输出token会发生部分坍缩。这是仅在输入空间对编码器进行监督的自然结果，这种方式对特征空间中冗余的token维度没有任何约束。我们提出OTISv2，通过在输入空间重建目标的基础上补充两个特征空间目标来抑制坍缩：一个是针对指数移动平均教师的自蒸馏损失，另一个是KoLeo正则化器。在匹配的训练条件下，所得编码器相比其前代模型降低了输出token的余弦相似度并提升了有效秩，且能从7.1M参数到116M参数实现单调的性能扩展，而其前代模型则无法做到这一点。

arXiv:2611.20981v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: General-purpose time series encoders promise a single backbone that generalises across tasks and domains; however, they currently do not scale. We trace this down to a critical point of failure: under the predominant masked data modelling supervision, the encoder's output tokens partially collapse. This is the natural consequence of supervising encoders only in the input space, which leaves no constraint against redundant token dimensions in the feature space. We introduce OTISv2, which suppresses the collapse by complementing the reconstruction objective in input space with two objectives in the feature space: a self-distillation loss against an exponential-moving-average teacher, and a KoLeo regulariser. Under matched training, the resulting encoder reduces the cosine similarity and lifts the effective rank of its output tokens relative to its predecessor, and it scales monotonically from 7.1 M to 116 M parameters where its predecess

item.title: 提出STORMGUIDE-FL联邦优化与数据挖掘框架，通过服务器引导的数据获取与本地训练流程，结合轻量级客户端采样策略，同时缓解联邦流式数据挖掘中的局部概念漂移与全局客户端漂移（双重客户端异构性）。
item.description:
STORMGUIDE-FL：用于高效挖掘联邦流式数据的随机远程引导

STORMGUIDE-FL: Stochastic Remote Guidance for Efficient Mining of Federated Streaming Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20975

提出STORMGUIDE-FL联邦优化与数据挖掘框架，通过服务器引导的数据获取与本地训练流程，结合轻量级客户端采样策略，同时缓解联邦流式数据挖掘中的局部概念漂移与全局客户端漂移（双重客户端异构性）。

联邦学习能够在保护数据隐私的同时，实现跨分布式边缘设备（“客户端”）的协作式模型训练。然而，在现实世界的部署中，客户端需要在严格的资源限制下，观察来自不断演化环境的连续数据流。现有解决方案仍然面临两大挑战：局部概念漂移，即每个客户端的数据分布随时间发生偏移；以及全局客户端漂移，它源于异构训练参与者的异步参与和不均衡贡献，可被正式描述为双重客户端异构性。我们提出STORMGUIDE-FL，这是一个联邦优化与数据挖掘框架，通过服务器引导的数据获取与本地训练流程来缓解这两类漂移。在数据获取方面，一种轻量级的客户端采样策略从非平稳、非独立同分布（non-IID）的本地数据流中增量式地选择信息丰富且多样化的实例……

arXiv:2611.20975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated Learning enables collaborative model training across distributed edge devices ("clients") while preserving data privacy. However, real-world deployments involve clients that observe continuous data streams from evolving environments while operating under strict resource limitations. Existing solutions still face two major challenges: local concept drift, where each client's data distribution shifts over time, and global client drift, arising from asynchronous engagement and imbalanced contributions across heterogeneous training participants, formally described as dual client heterogeneity. We propose STORMGUIDE-FL, a federated optimization and data-mining framework that mitigates both types of drift using a server-guided pipeline for data acquisition and local training. item.title: 提出FARCH模型，通过在曲线及其平方残差上复用同一个基于小波半度量的核加权方案，联合非参数地预测函数型数据的条件均值与波动率，从而构建出逐点和一致（上确界范数）两种校准预测带。
item.description:
FARCH：用于校准预测带的函数型ARCH模型

FARCH: A Functional ARCH Model for Calibrated Prediction Bands

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20972

提出FARCH模型，通过在曲线及其平方残差上复用同一个基于小波半度量的核加权方案，联合非参数地预测函数型数据的条件均值与波动率，从而构建出逐点和一致（上确界范数）两种校准预测带。

预测一条完整的曲线，而非其少数几个标量摘要，需要一种本身即为函数型的不确定性概念。我们提出FARCH——一种具有条件异方差的函数型非线性自回归模型，其中下一条曲线的条件均值和条件波动率通过重复使用同一个核加权方案进行联合非参数预测：该方案建立在曲线之间的小波半度量之上，先应用于曲线本身，再应用于其平方残差。基于这一对估计量，我们推导出两种预测带的构造：一种是逐点预测带，由边际情景分位数获得；另一种是关于上确界范数的一致预测带，为涉及整条预测路径而非任何单一时刻的决策进行校准。该方法应用于1996至2009年法国全国半小时电力需求的日前预测任务，并在完全相同的实验协议下与四种现有方法进行了比较……

arXiv:2611.20972v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Forecasting a curve, rather than a handful of scalar summaries of it, requires a notion of uncertainty that is itself functional. We propose FARCH, a functional nonlinear autoregressive model with conditional heteroscedasticity, in which the conditional mean and the conditional volatility of the next curve are forecasted jointly and nonparametrically, by reusing a single kernel weighting scheme --- built on a wavelet semi-metric between curves --- first on the curves themselves and then on their squared residuals. From this pair of estimators we derive two constructions of prediction bands: a pointwise band, obtained from marginal scenario quantiles, and a uniform, sup-norm band, calibrated for decisions that concern the entire forecasted path rather than any single instant. item.title: 该论文提出用希尔伯特状态刻画部分可观测下的决策歧义性，给出了零遗憾准则与二元动作遗憾的精确公式，并揭示了何种信息恰好能保留基于观测的最优决策。
item.description:
部分可观测决策的希尔伯特状态

Hilbert States for Decision-Making under Partial Observability

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20970

该论文提出用希尔伯特状态刻画部分可观测下的决策歧义性，给出了零遗憾准则与二元动作遗憾的精确公式，并揭示了何种信息恰好能保留基于观测的最优决策。

摘要：部分可观测条件下的决策可能在根本上受制于信息，即使系统动态已知也是如此：不同的物理状态可能产生相同的观测历史，却偏好不同的动作。我们研究三个问题：何时全状态最优性无法实现，什么信息恰好能保留基于观测的最佳决策，以及有限数据学习如何影响可靠性？首先，我们通过条件动作偏好来刻画决策歧义性。我们给出了一个零遗憾准则、对于正概率区域上具有一致正成本差距的冲突唯一最优动作的正下界，以及一个精确的二元动作遗憾公式。这也说明了为什么仅有物理状态歧义不一定会导致决策损失。其次，对于平面上的两个动作和平方终端目标成本，我们推导出了条件期望成本差异的精确内积表示，使用了三个……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.20970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decision-making under partial observability can be fundamentally limited by information, even with known dynamics: distinct physical states can induce the same observation history while favoring different actions. We study three questions: when is full-state optimality unattainable, what information exactly preserves the best observation-based decision, and how does finite-data learning affect reliability? First, we characterize decision ambiguity through conditional action preferences. We give a zero-regret criterion, a positive lower bound for conflicting uniquely optimal actions on positive-probability regions with uniformly positive cost gaps, and an exact binary-action regret formula. This also shows why physical-state ambiguity alone need not cause decision loss. item.title: 本文在十个预注册实验中用 Claude Opus 5.5 复现了“权重空间编程”研究，证明大模型可以直接读写以文本形式呈现的神经网络权重——凭权重识别游戏与谄媚微调模型、一次性修复失败策略，并零样本编写出在多数环境上胜过训练十万步 PPO 的网络。
item.description:
相同的修复，不同的权重：使用 Claude 复现权重空间编程

Same Fix, Different Weights: Replicating Weight-Space Programming with Claude

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20953

本文在十个预注册实验中用 Claude Opus 5.5 复现了“权重空间编程”研究，证明大模型可以直接读写以文本形式呈现的神经网络权重——凭权重识别游戏与谄媚微调模型、一次性修复失败策略，并零样本编写出在多数环境上胜过训练十万步 PPO 的网络。

Takehi 等人（2026）报告称，GPT-6 Astra 在以文本形式接收小型神经网络的权重时，能够说出这些网络被训练来做什么、修复它们，并在无需训练的情况下编写新的网络。我在十个预先注册的实验中使用 Claude Opus 5.5 重新运行了该研究的核心部分，实验包含未训练网络和置换对照组，并对每个沙盒代码单元进行了人工审计。权重阅读能力的结果喜忧参半：Claude 从策略权重中识别出了 4 个 Atari 游戏中的 3 个，并在 15/15 次字符级语言模型运行中都找到了被测量的复制头，但其关于训练数据的回答往往受先验知识影响。与原研究不同的是，它在 6/6 次运行中仅凭权重就识别出了一个谄媚的 Gemma 3 270M 微调模型。一次性权重编辑将一个失败的 MountainCar 策略从 0% 成功率提升到 100%，将一个悬停不动的 LunarLander 策略从 0% 提升到 85.6%；零样本编写的网络在 5 个环境中的 4 个上于 10 万步时击败了 PPO，且每个网络都实现了一个教科书式的控制器。在没有任何训练或前向传播的情况下，Claude 写……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.20953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Takehi et al. (2026) report that GPT-6 Astra, given the weights of small neural networks as text, can say what they were trained to do, repair them, and write new ones without training. I re-ran the core of that study with Claude Opus 5.5 in ten pre-registered experiments, with untrained-network and permutation controls and hand audits of every sandboxed code cell. Reading was mixed: Claude named 3 of 4 Atari games from policy weights and found the measured copying heads in 15/15 character-LM runs, but its answers about training data often followed priors. Unlike the original, it identified a sycophantic Gemma 3 270M finetune from weights alone in 6/6 runs. One-shot weight edits took a failing MountainCar policy from 0% to 100% success and a hovering LunarLander policy from 0% to 85.6%; zero-shot networks beat PPO at 100k steps on 4 of 5 environments, each implementing a textbook controller. item.title: 该论文提出PACIL方法，为每张无标注图像构建标签后验分布作为软标签，通过先验选择规则校正类别先验并以白化特征上的固定先验von Mises-Fisher混合模型精炼分布，使得基于后验训练的解析分类器在期望意义上等同于真实标签训练的结果。
item.description:
学习真实标签所能传授的知识：基于无标注数据的后验解析式类增量学习

Learning What the True Labels Would Teach: Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning with Unlabeled Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20937

该论文提出PACIL方法，为每张无标注图像构建标签后验分布作为软标签，通过先验选择规则校正类别先验并以白化特征上的固定先验von Mises-Fisher混合模型精炼分布，使得基于后验训练的解析分类器在期望意义上等同于真实标签训练的结果。

在无标注数据的类增量学习中，每个任务仅提供类别名称和无标注图像，因此CLIP的零样本预测被用来替代标签。现有方法在硬伪标签上训练，但错误的伪标签会给真实类别赋予零概率，而自训练往往进一步强化这种错误。我们主张每张图像都应携带其标签后验分布，因为以后验分布训练的解析分类器在期望意义上等同于以真实标签训练的分类器。然而零样本预测并非该后验分布，因为其类别比例将名称偏差与真实类别不平衡混为一谈，且忽略了其他图像的信息。我们提出后验解析类增量学习方法，通过先验选择规则校正类别先验，并在白化特征上使用固定先验的von Mises-Fisher混合模型精炼每个分布。这些软标签不仅用于训练分类器，还替代标签，通过闭式留一交叉验证来选择分类器与零样本CLIP的融合权重。

arXiv:2611.20937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In class-incremental learning with unlabeled data, each task brings only class names and unlabeled images, so CLIP's zero-shot predictions replace labels. Existing methods train on hard pseudo-labels, but a wrong one gives the true class zero probability, which self-training often confirms. We argue that each image should carry its label posterior, as an analytic classifier trained on posteriors equals the true-label one in expectation. The zero-shot prediction is not this posterior, as its class proportions confound name bias with true imbalance and it ignores other images. We propose Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning (PACIL), which corrects the class prior with a prior selection rule and refines each distribution by a fixed-prior von Mises-Fisher mixture on whitened features. These soft labels train the classifier and replace labels to select its fusion weight with zero-shot CLIP by closed-form leave-one-out cross-validatio

item.title: 当工具发生静默变更时，智能体积累的经验会导致其照搬过时的调用方式而失败，表现甚至不如新手，这一现象被称为“经验腐化”。
item.description:
经验腐化：经验丰富的智能体在新手能成功之处失败

Experience Rot: Experienced Agents Fail Where Novices Succeed

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20922

当工具发生静默变更时，智能体积累的经验会导致其照搬过时的调用方式而失败，表现甚至不如新手，这一现象被称为“经验腐化”。

智能体越来越多地被设计为从经验中学习：它们保存对话历史、记忆文件、检索到的笔记和技能，并复用之前有效的方法。我们证明，当工具发生静默变更时，这些经验反而会反噬它们。我们使用以模型上下文协议（MCP）形式定义的工具对一系列模型进行了测试。在静默变更之后，经验丰富的智能体在大多数任务上失败，而对任务陌生的智能体大多能够成功。我们将这种失败称为“经验腐化”。经验丰富的智能体会照搬之前的调用，而不是检查当前的工具接口，即使工具定义中已经明确显示了变更。随后它们还会报告成功。当文档不完整时，经验恰恰是智能体成功的关键；而在变更之后，同样的经验反而使它们的处境比毫无经验更糟。这种失败在我们测试的每一种记忆形式中都会出现，并随着经验积累量的增加而加剧。简单的补救措施收效甚微：宣布更新几乎无法缓解……

arXiv:2611.20922v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agents are increasingly built to learn from experience: they keep conversation histories, memory files, retrieved notes and skills, and reuse what worked before. We show that this experience turns against them when their tools change silently. We test a range of models with tools defined as in the Model Context Protocol (MCP). After a silent change, experienced agents fail on most tasks, while agents new to the task mostly succeed. We call this failure Experience Rot. Experienced agents copy their earlier call instead of checking the current interface, even when the tool definition shows the change. Then they report success. When the documentation is incomplete, experience is what makes agents succeed. After a change, the same experience leaves them worse off than no experience at all. The failure appears in every form of memory we test and grows with the amount of experience. Simple remedies fall short: announcing the update barely he

item.title: 该论文提出了一种基于PLNets结构化神经网络与按设计稳定的替代模型的新框架，能够同时联合学习控制李雅普诺夫函数和镇定控制器，无需预先已知CLF即可保证闭环系统稳定性。
item.description:
基于按设计稳定的替代模型的控制李雅普诺夫函数与控制器联合学习

Joint Learning of Control Lyapunov Functions and Controllers via Stable-by-Design Surrogates

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20900

该论文提出了一种基于PLNets结构化神经网络与按设计稳定的替代模型的新框架，能够同时联合学习控制李雅普诺夫函数和镇定控制器，无需预先已知CLF即可保证闭环系统稳定性。

训练和验证基于神经网络的控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）在计算上可能非常耗时。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种利用结构化神经网络和基于投影的参数化方法来联合学习CLF和镇定控制器的框架。具体而言，我们采用Polyak-Lojasiewicz网络（PLNets）对非凸、正定的CLF候选函数进行参数化，并构建了闭环动力学的按设计稳定的替代模型，该模型在构造上即满足李雅普诺夫递减条件。所提出的控制器将线性状态反馈与类似于Sontag通用公式的高阶校正项相结合，并通过训练使得到的闭环动力学与该按设计稳定的替代模型保持一致。与基于Sontag公式的经典方法不同，我们的框架不需要已知的CLF，而是同时学习CLF和控制器。我们建立了局部和全局稳定性保证（原文在此处截断）。

To address this challenge, we propose a framework that jointly learns a CLF and a stabilizing controller using structured neural networks and a projection-based parameterization. The controller combines linear state feedback with a higher-order correction term resembling Sontag's universal formula and is trained to align the resulting closed-loop dynamics with the stable-by-design surrogate. 本文为门控视觉状态空间模型提出了一个可认证的可解释性框架：在固定门控模式下屏蔽因果卷积输入并给关闭令牌零权重，可在数学上保证被关闭令牌对概念和任务预测完全无影响，并在 LIDC-IDRI 肺结节实验中逐路径验证了这一保证。

基于 Mamba 构建的视觉模型通常通过其选择性步长 Delta 来解释，其假设是扫描未接纳的令牌无法影响预测。我们在一个基于单个门控、双向选择性状态空间块的肺结节恶性程度概念瓶颈模型中对这一假设进行了检验。答案构成一个可解释性框架：一个保证、一个检验该保证的程序，以及对它所解释内容的预注册审计。对于固定的门控模式，屏蔽该块因果卷积的输入并在读出时给被关闭的令牌赋予零权重，可使概念和任务逻辑值对被关闭的令牌完全不变。门控 Delta 既非必要条件也非充分条件。在 LIDC-IDRI 数据集上，对 15 个交叉验证模型进行的逐路径敲除实验在每次运行中都与此一致：当条件成立时，最大逻辑值变化恰好为 0；当条件不成立时，则在 4.1 到 6.7 之间。该门控模型达到了（摘要在此处截断）

We test that in a concept bottleneck model for lung-nodule malignancy built on a single gated, bidirectional selective state-space block. The answer becomes an interpretability framework: a guarantee, a procedure that checks it, and a pre-registered audit of what it explains. Gating Delta is neither necessary nor sufficient. item.title: ConvRSI通过在潜在空间中结合智能体内卷积与智能体间图卷积，实现多智能体自我改进的并行化，在MATH-500上取得5.04%性能提升的同时显著降低推理成本和延迟。
item.description:
从递归到卷积：多智能体系统的并行自我改进

From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20891

ConvRSI通过在潜在空间中结合智能体内卷积与智能体间图卷积，实现多智能体自我改进的并行化，在MATH-500上取得5.04%性能提升的同时显著降低推理成本和延迟。

多智能体自我改进使智能体能够通过交互和反馈不断提升自身。然而，智能体之间和改进轮次之间的顺序依赖可能导致错误传播、增加计算成本并限制并行性。此外，孤立地改进单个特征或单个智能体可能会忽视它们之间的依赖关系，并限制集体协调能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ConvRSI，一个通过卷积实现多智能体自我改进并行化的框架。ConvRSI将智能体内卷积（联合改进相关的智能体特征）与智能体间图卷积（根据协作拓扑结构聚合消息）相结合。两个阶段均在潜在空间中运行，实现并行更新而无需反复解码和重新编码中间消息。在MATH-500上的实验表明，ConvRSI在实现5.04%性能提升的同时，降低了17.27%的推理成本和45.11%的延迟。

arXiv:2611.20891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency
