item.title: 该论文将注意力汇聚理论化为token空间协方差中的低秩谱模态，并证明SDPA后门控通过模态依赖的收缩在前向传播中抑制汇聚谱能量、在反向传播中削减汇聚梯度，从而从机制上统一解释了门控为何能缓解注意力汇聚。
item.description:
注意力汇聚作为谱尖峰：门控注意力的机制分析

Attention Sinks as Spectral Spikes: A Mechanism Analysis of Gated Attention

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20403

该论文将注意力汇聚理论化为token空间协方差中的低秩谱模态，并证明SDPA后门控通过模态依赖的收缩在前向传播中抑制汇聚谱能量、在反向传播中削减汇聚梯度，从而从机制上统一解释了门控为何能缓解注意力汇聚。

Transformer注意力表现出“注意力汇聚”现象，即一小部分源token在各层中吸收了不成比例的注意力质量。近期研究表明，SDPA之后的输出门控能显著减少注意力汇聚行为；另有研究通过反向传播训练动态将注意力汇聚与梯度汇聚和大规模激活联系起来。然而，同一门控机制如何影响前向汇聚结构、反向梯度集中以及训练时的表示特征，仍不清楚。我们通过将注意力汇聚形式化为token空间协方差中由汇聚诱导的低秩模态来填补这一空白，其方向与高质量注意力列对齐。在这一视角下，SDPA后门控表现为一种模态依赖的收缩：它在前向传播中衰减汇聚诱导的谱能量，并在反向传播中局部减少经由汇聚列传递的值路径梯度。经验上，随机矩阵诊断表明门控……（摘要原文在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.20403v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Transformer attention exhibits attention sinks, where a small subset of source tokens absorbs disproportionate attention mass across layers. Recent work shows that post-SDPA output gating strongly reduces attention-sink behavior, while separate studies link attention sinks to gradient sinks and massive activations through backward training dynamics. Yet how the same gate affects forward sink structure, backward gradient concentration, and training-time representation signatures remains unclear. We address this gap by formulating attention sinks as sink-induced low-rank modes in token-space covariance, with directions aligned to high-mass attention columns. Under this view, post-SDPA gating acts as a mode-dependent contraction: it attenuates sink-induced spectral energy in the forward pass and locally reduces value-path gradients routed through sink columns in the backward pass. item.title: 该论文针对参数受限的相干光神经网络，提出保持高表达能力的两个关键架构原则——变换的统计均匀性与每个参数的强混合能力，并据此开发了一种基于蝶形拓扑的对数深度架构来实现参数高效的酉变换。
item.description:
相干光神经网络中参数高效酉变换的架构原则

Architectural Principles for Parameter-Efficient Unitary Transformations in Coherent Optical Neural Networks

在充满不确定性的高风险环境中，集合值预测通过为每个测试实例给出多个潜在标签作为预测，提供了一种谨慎且稳健的机制，以降低预测错误带来的潜在风险。然而，在诸如带赌博机反馈的在线学习等场景下，将这一范式与分布外（OOD）检测相结合的研究仍然很少。赌博机反馈机制只告知学习者所选择的臂/动作是否正确，而不是显式的真实标签，因此当采取错误动作时，真实的类别标签是未知的。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了BanditGPS，它在赌博机反馈设置下进行带OOD检测的集合值预测，并利用对类别标签真实值的估计。BanditGPS实现了三个目标：给出小而富有信息量的预测集、提升OOD检测性能，以及

arXiv:2611.20387v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In high-stakes environments where uncertainties abound, set-valued prediction offers a cautious and robust mechanism by presenting multiple potential labels as the prediction for each test instance to mitigate the potential risk associated with prediction errors. arXiv:2611.20384v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: GPTQ is the de facto standard solver for layer-wise post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models, yet the solver itself has received less attention than weight preprocessing and cross-layer objectives. 循环序列模型，如循环神经网络（RNN）和状态空间模型（SSM），通常被训练为在输出序列完成时发出一个序列结束标记（EOS）。在训练过程中，EOS被视为另一个普通标记，没有专门的损失项或激励机制。尽管这种训练范式被广泛使用，但模型如何决定输出EOS尚不清楚。我们研究了EOS停止问题的一个最小版本，其中网络被训练为按指示的次数重复发出给定输入序列，然后发出EOS。我们在该任务上训练了tanh RNN和线性SSM，发现RNN在一个线性子空间中编码剩余待复制的标记数量，其中两个主成分捕获了大部分变化。具有相同剩余计数的隐藏状态无论其指示的重复次数如何，都会收敛到一个共享表示。通过在边界处使用仿射变换调制隐藏状态……

arXiv:2611.20377v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recurrent sequence models, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and state space models (SSMs), are often trained to emit an end-of-sequence (EOS) token when their output sequence is complete. During training, EOS is treated as another token without a special loss term or incentive. Although this training paradigm is widely used, it is not understood how models decide to output EOS. We study a minimal version of the EOS halting problem in which networks are trained to emit a given input sequence an instructed number of times, followed by EOS. We train tanh RNNs and linear SSMs on this task, finding that the RNNs encode the number of tokens left to copy in a linear subspace, of which two principal components capture most of the variation. 线性探针是机械可解释性研究中的一种常用技术，然而某个特征的可解码性并不一定意味着网络确实使用了该特征。干预忠实性，而非仅仅可解码性，才是判断一个特征是否在模型中发挥实际作用的标准。与此同时，探针正则化已被用于特征发现，但正则化对特征因果性的影响仍不清楚。我们系统地研究了探针正则化，从无正则化的普通最小二乘（OLS）回归开始，并考察通过岭回归逐步增加正则化强度的效果。我们从理论上证明，OLS探针会放大激活空间中与目标特征存在虚假相关性的低方差方向，而正则化能够降低这些方向的影响。在实验上，我们在玩具transformer和Llama-2-7B中发现，干预忠实性……

arXiv:2611.20368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides spatially resolved gene expression measurements, but most 3D ST datasets are acquired as independently processed 2D sections. Computational approaches span slice registration and integration, explicit or generative interpolation, and coordinate-field modeling. Within the last family, implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous, coordinate-queryable parameterization, but standard isotropic coordinate encodings do not explicitly reflect that serial-section measurements are dense in-plane and sparse along the axial direction. We present HoloGene, an anisotropic conditional INR framework for estimating continuous 3D gene-expression fields from pre-registered ST sections. Its central contribution is an acquisition-aware factorization that couples dense in-plane synthesis with sparse axial evolution using established GAE, FiLM, pseudo-label supervision, and CORAL components. 该论文融合三大时间序列特征库提取3286个特征，通过两步特征选择筛选出18个紧凑无冗余特征，并以统计检验系统验证了14种分类器在振荡检测及稳定/失步判别中的性能。

电力系统振荡期间发生的故障，以及振荡演变为失步（不稳定）状态，会导致距离继电器误动作和连锁停电事故。本文在PSCAD/EMTDC中建模的9节点WSCC系统上，实现了对故障、振荡期间故障以及电力系统振荡的识别，并区分稳定振荡与失步振荡。该方法将三个时间序列特征库应用于三相继电器电压和电流信号，每个事件窗口可提取3286个统计、时域、频谱和分形特征描述子。通过两步特征选择（先进行Boruta全相关特征筛选，随后采用RFECV和SHAP引导的最小最优剪枝），将特征集缩减为18个紧凑且无冗余的特征。随后对涵盖线性、核/基于实例、概率模型、神经网络以及树集成/提升等家族的14种分类器进行基准测试，采用重复分层交叉验证，并通过Friedman/Nemenyi检验评估模型间的性能差异。

确定相关均衡的支撑复杂度

Settling the Support Complexity of Correlated Equilibria

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20362

本文通过在两人零和博弈中建立匹配的下界，解决了相关均衡支撑复杂度的长期开放问题，证明已有的 O(log² N/ε⁴) 上界是紧致最优的。

我们研究两人博弈中近似相关均衡（CE）的支撑复杂度，即在近似两人矩阵博弈的相关均衡时，必须被赋予正概率的纯动作组合的最小数量。对于 ε-近似粗相关均衡，在 N×N 博弈中，大小为 O(log N/ε²) 的支撑即可实现常数近似。对于相关均衡，此前已知的最好上界为 O(log² N/ε⁴) [Babichenko 等，2014, 2017]，但该上界是否紧致仍是悬而未决的问题。我们建立了一个匹配的下界，从而解决了 Ko 和 Schvartzman [2017] 提出的开放问题。具体而言，我们证明，即使仅限于两人零和博弈，对于每个 1≤k≤N^(1/2)，由至多 k 个纯动作组合支撑的分布所能达到的最坏情形相关均衡差距为 Θ(min{1, √(log N)/k^(1/4)}。

振子网络中的同步与聚集现象依赖于相位的联合分布。流匹配可以通过从成对构型之间的最短弧学习角速度场来引导该分布。每条弧以恒定速度被遍历，但由此得到的速度场可以沿其自身轨迹发生变化。在本文中，我们研究了在每次控制器评估选定一个速率并保持到下一次更新之前的情况下，如何控制圆周与乘积环面上的角度输运。利用相同的局部速度样本，流匹配学习瞬时角速率，而 MeanFlow 学习其在控制区间内沿参考轨迹的平均角速率。在直接角度驱动下，保持精确的平均速率即可实现参考位移。我们将保持瞬时速率所产生的位移误差以及 MeanFlow 的训练残差与教师速度的条件协方差联系起来。实验（原文摘要在此处截断）……

疫情预测为公共卫生决策提供支持，涵盖从资源容量规划到干预时机选择等多个方面，其中点预测精度和校准良好的不确定性都至关重要。尽管神经网络模型已推动了点预测的发展，但在多个未来时间步上产生可靠的概率预测仍具挑战性。更新模型能够编码疫情传播过程，而神经预测器可以学习灵活的多时间步表示；如何在概率化的未来滚动预测中整合这两者的优势仍缺乏深入研究。我们提出了EPI-SST（Epidemic State Space Transformer，流行病状态空间Transformer），这是一种以证据驱动的更新转移为核心的概率预测器。在每个预测时间步，神经证据对内部乘子产生有界更新，并推进具有有限记忆的更新状态，从而生成未来的均值轨迹。此外，一个独立的异方差高斯头通过验证集选择的对数方差惩罚来控制预测尺度……

arXiv:2611.20346v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A ReLU pattern variety records the polynomial relations among the coefficients of the affine maps associated with a prescribed set of activation patterns of a ReLU network. We study how the combinatorics of the canonical set of activation patterns of an unbiased ReLU network is reflected in the geometry of its pattern variety. item.title: 该论文提出一种基于 Hilbert-Schmidt 算子偏差的谱对齐准则来选择地标点，使核平移空间逼近正定核的主特征子空间，并证明最优地标配置是特征函数采样矩阵为缩放等距映射的均匀分布点集，且在齐性空间上等价于最小等权求积规则。
item.description:
谱地标点：地标核平移与核算子主特征函数的对齐

Spectral Landmarks: Alignment of Landmark Kernel Translates with the Leading Eigenfunctions of a Kernel Operator

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20336

该论文提出一种基于 Hilbert-Schmidt 算子偏差的谱对齐准则来选择地标点，使核平移空间逼近正定核的主特征子空间，并证明最优地标配置是特征函数采样矩阵为缩放等距映射的均匀分布点集，且在齐性空间上等价于最小等权求积规则。

我们研究选择 $m$ 个地标点的问题，使得核平移的张成空间尽可能接近正定核的主 $s$ 维特征子空间。自然的度量是投影到这两个子空间上的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）投影子之间的 Hilbert-Schmidt 算子偏差。我们给出了以截断 Mercer 核表示的谱对齐函数的闭式表达式，并通过一个双侧夹逼界将其与经典的积分幂函数（Nyström 迹误差）联系起来。通过在地标坐标上进行梯度下降来最小化该函数，所产生的地标集是均匀间隔分布的。理论结果表明，最优配置是那些特征函数采样矩阵为缩放等距映射的配置。在齐性空间上，这些配置恰好是主特征函数乘积的最小等权求积规则，并且对于每个 $m \ge s$，它们是……

arXiv:2611.20336v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the problem of choosing $m$ landmark points so that the span of the kernel translates is as close as possible to the leading $s$-dimensional eigenspace of a positive-definite kernel. The natural measure is the Hilbert-Schmidt operator discrepancy between the reproducing-kernel-Hilbert-space (RKHS) projectors onto the two subspaces. We give a closed form spectral alignment function in terms of the truncated Mercer kernel and relate it to the classical integrated power function (Nystr\"om trace error) through a two-sided sandwich bound. Minimizing the function by gradient descent on the landmark coordinates produces landmark sets that are evenly spaced. Theoretical results show that optimal configurations are those whose eigenfunction sampling matrix is a scaled isometry. item.title: 该论文系统比较了逐点打分、集合打分和候选对象注意力三种候选评分方式，发现逐点打分总体仍有竞争力，集合打分在特定任务上更优且经关系训练后能学习候选间依赖并泛化，而候选对象注意力即使允许跨候选交互也未带来稳定提升。
item.description:
决策模型何时应该比较候选对象？

When Should Decision Models Compare Candidates?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20335

该论文系统比较了逐点打分、集合打分和候选对象注意力三种候选评分方式，发现逐点打分总体仍有竞争力，集合打分在特定任务上更优且经关系训练后能学习候选间依赖并泛化，而候选对象注意力即使允许跨候选交互也未带来稳定提升。

语言模型智能体经常需要在候选动作（如工具和网页元素）之间进行选择。决策模型应该独立地为候选对象打分，还是允许其分数依赖于其他候选对象？我们通过比较三种方法来研究这一问题：逐点打分、集合打分和候选对象注意力。在五个智能体决策基准上，逐点打分依然具有竞争力，而集合打分在某些工具选择和二元决策任务上表现更好。尽管候选对象注意力允许跨候选对象的交互，但它并未持续超越逐点打分。借助两个受控的合成任务，我们进一步考察了模型是否学会利用候选集信息。通过有针对性的关系训练，集合打分模型能够学习候选对象之间的依赖关系并泛化到分布偏移的输入，而候选对象注意力的迁移能力较弱。我们的结果表明，能够访问其他候选对象并不保证模型能有效利用候选集信息。

arXiv:2611.20335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language-model agents frequently select among candidate actions, such as tools and web elements. Should decision models score candidates independently or allow their scores to depend on other candidates? We investigate this question by comparing three approaches: Pointwise scoring, Setwise scoring, and Candidate Attention. Across five agent-decision benchmarks, Pointwise scoring remains competitive, while Setwise scoring performs better on some tool-selection and binary-decision tasks. Candidate Attention does not consistently improve upon Pointwise scoring, despite allowing cross-candidate interaction. Using two controlled synthetic tasks, we further examine whether models learn to use candidate-set information. With targeted relational training, Setwise models learn candidate dependencies and generalize to shifted inputs, while Candidate Attention shows weaker transfer. item.title: 提出RT-FM无监督框架，利用时序变分自编码器估计残差潜在尾部性并转化为有界预热潮退权重来引导流匹配训练，避免过度惩罚稀有正常窗口，从而减少误报并提升时间序列异常检测的整体性能。
item.description:
基于残差尾部信息的流匹配时间序列异常检测

Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20334

提出RT-FM无监督框架，利用时序变分自编码器估计残差潜在尾部性并转化为有界预热潮退权重来引导流匹配训练，避免过度惩罚稀有正常窗口，从而减少误报并提升时间序列异常检测的整体性能。

时间序列异常检测（TSAD）模型通常使用平均风险目标在正常数据上进行训练，这类目标侧重于占主导地位的正常模式。然而，真实时间序列中可能包含在训练分布中代表性不足的稀有但有效的正常状态。我们证明，数据空间的流匹配可能会过度惩罚这类稀有正常窗口，并赋予它们与真正异常相当的异常分数。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了残差尾部信息流匹配（RT-FM），这是一个无监督框架，它使用时序变分自编码器来估计残差潜在尾部性，并将其转换为有界的、预热潮退的权重，用于训练数据空间的流匹配模型。在七个TSAD基准上的实验表明，RT-FM在保持强大异常判别能力的同时，提高了对稀有正常模式的覆盖，显著减少了此类窗口上的误报，从而提升了整体检测性能。

arXiv:2611.20334v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) models are often trained on nominal data using average-risk objectives, which emphasize dominant normal patterns. However, real time series can contain rare but valid nominal regimes that are underrepresented in the training distribution. We show that data-space flow matching can over-penalize such rare-normal windows and assign them anomaly scores comparable to those of true anomalies. To address this, we propose Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching (RT-FM), an unsupervised framework that uses a temporal variational autoencoder to estimate residual latent tailness and converts it into bounded, warmup-annealed weights for training a data-space flow matching model. item.title: LENS 框架将 Transformer 中的 LayerNorm 和 Softmax 重新表述为可学习的微型 MLP，把更多计算转化为硬件友好的 GEMM 操作，从而显著降低硬件加速器的资源消耗。
item.description:
LENS：用可学习的归一化状态替换 Transformer 中的 LayerNorm 和 Softmax

LENS: Replacing LayerNorm and Softmax in Transformers with Learnable Normalization States

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20331

LENS 框架将 Transformer 中的 LayerNorm 和 Softmax 重新表述为可学习的微型 MLP，把更多计算转化为硬件友好的 GEMM 操作，从而显著降低硬件加速器的资源消耗。

LayerNorm 和注意力 Softmax 是 Transformer 中的关键操作。然而，它们无法高效地映射到硬件上的通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）计算。因此，现代硬件加速器设计（如 ASIC/FPGA 上的 NPU）需要消耗大量硬件资源或芯片面积来实现其专用的算术单元。基于先前关于 LayerNorm、Softmax 及其替代方法的研究工作，我们提出了可学习归一化状态（LENS）框架，该框架通过从相关方法中抽象出共同结构，将 LayerNorm 重新表述为微型 MLP，并将该方法扩展到 Softmax，从而将 Transformer 中更多的计算转移到 GEMM 上，形成一种硬件友好的架构。我们在基于 Vision Transformer (ViT) 的图像分类任务和基于 Pythia 模型的自回归语言建模任务上对 LENS 进行了评估，并在 WikiText 和 LAMBADA 上进行了泛化测试。在这些任务中，LENS 的表现与原始方法相当（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.20331v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LayerNorm and attention Softmax are critical operations in Transformers. However, they cannot be efficiently mapped to General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) computations on hardware. Therefore, modern hardware accelerator designs, such as NPUs on ASIC/FPGA, consume a large amount of hardware resources or chip area to implement their specific arithmetic units. Building on previous work about LayerNorm, Softmax, and their alternatives, we introduce Learnable Normalization States (LENS), a framework that reformulates LayerNorm as tiny MLPs by abstracting a common structure from related methods and extends this method to Softmax, which moves more of the computation in Transformers to GEMM as a hardware-friendly architecture. We evaluate LENS on image classification with Vision Transformers (ViT) and autoregressive language modeling with Pythia models, including generalization tests on WikiText and LAMBADA. Across these tasks, LENS matches o

item.title: 本文提出了基于MMD的“不连贯性比率”来衡量模型更新过程偏离连贯性（即当前预测与更新后预期预测的一致性）的程度，并刻画了不连贯性何时会影响诸如主动学习和贝叶斯实验设计等顺序决策。
item.description:
衡量预测模型中的连贯性

Measuring Coherence in Predictive Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20325

本文提出了基于MMD的“不连贯性比率”来衡量模型更新过程偏离连贯性（即当前预测与更新后预期预测的一致性）的程度，并刻画了不连贯性何时会影响诸如主动学习和贝叶斯实验设计等顺序决策。

许多顺序决策过程（如主动学习）隐含地假设模型的当前预测与它在根据新数据进行更新后预期做出的预测相一致，我们将这一性质称为连贯性。大多数实际使用的模型并不通过精确的条件化进行更新，因此不保证具有连贯性，这可能导致更差的决策。然而，目前尚无通用的方法来衡量不连贯性，也无法判断它何时会产生影响。我们开发了衡量不连贯性的工具，并刻画了它何时会影响决策。我们提出了“不连贯性比率”，这是一种基于MMD的度量方法，用于衡量任何更新过程偏离连贯性的程度，且仅从该过程自身的预测和更新中计算得出，同时我们还提供了一个随时有效的连贯性检验方法。在贝叶斯实验设计中，对于连贯模型而言等价的采集目标，在我们研究的每一个近似模型下都会选择不同的数据，而不连贯性比率能够追踪这种……

arXiv:2611.20325v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many sequential decision-making procedures, such as active learning, implicitly assume that a model's current predictions agree with those it expects to make after updating on new data, a property we call coherence. Most models in use do not update by exact conditioning and are not guaranteed to be coherent, which can lead to worse decisions. Yet there is currently no general way to measure incoherence or to tell when it matters. We develop tools to measure incoherence and characterise when it affects decisions. We introduce the incoherence ratio, an MMD-based measure of how far any updating procedure departs from coherence, computed only from the procedure's own predictions and updates, and accompany it with an anytime-valid test of coherence. item.title: 该论文通过一个刻意简化的单目姿态估计器，在SPEED+仿真到真实基准上系统探究模拟器辐射度误设造成的合成到真实差距，发现模型在失效时仍表现出不合理的过度自信。
item.description:
模拟器误设带来的不合理自信：SPEED+仿真到真实基准上的方向性鲁棒性

Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20321

该论文通过一个刻意简化的单目姿态估计器，在SPEED+仿真到真实基准上系统探究模拟器辐射度误设造成的合成到真实差距，发现模型在失效时仍表现出不合理的过度自信。

面向轨道的视觉导航系统几乎必须完全依靠合成图像进行训练，因为在轨飞行的特定航天器几乎不存在真实带标注的图像。像SPEED+这样的基准正是为此类情形而构建的：训练集来自模拟器，测试集则是卫星模型在两种光照条件下的真实图像。该模拟器近似了光线从聚酯薄膜和铝表面反射的方式，但和所有科学模拟器一样，它存在设定误差。其误差属于辐射度层面，因为它缺失了真实图像中常见的镜面高光、硬阴影和传感器饱和现象。我们用一个刻意保持简单的单目姿态估计器来探究由此产生的合成到真实差距——这是此类系统的核心风险。在一项关于骨干网络适配与光度增强的2×2研究中，模型在合成图像上训练，并在两个真实硬件在环域上进行测试，我们发现了三点结论。（1）模型并不知道它正在失效……

arXiv:2611.20321v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. item.title: 本文针对次梯度范数上界依赖于目标函数的凸优化问题建立了迭代次数下界，并提出投影GD（带预热-衰减步长调度）和标量步长裁剪AdamW两种在对数因子内达到该下界的近最优算法，后者还能处理随机次梯度估计的情形。
item.description:
广义Lipschitz凸优化的近最优方法

Near-Optimal Methods for Generalized Lipschitz Convex Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20318

本文针对次梯度范数上界依赖于目标函数的凸优化问题建立了迭代次数下界，并提出投影GD（带预热-衰减步长调度）和标量步长裁剪AdamW两种在对数因子内达到该下界的近最优算法，后者还能处理随机次梯度估计的情形。

在本文中，我们考虑了一类凸优化问题，其中次梯度范数的上界依赖于目标函数。我们建立了任何一阶方法找到该问题近似解所需的迭代次数下界。此外，我们提出了两种近最优算法，它们能够在对数因子范围内匹配该下界。第一种算法是投影梯度下降（GD），采用精心设计的步长调度方案，其中包含预热和衰减阶段。第二种算法是标量步长的裁剪AdamW，它将近最优保证扩展到了随机设定中，即仅能获得次梯度的带噪声无偏估计的情形。

arXiv:2611.20318v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we consider a convex optimization problem, where the upper bound on the subgradient norm depends on the objective function. We establish a lower bound on the number of iterations required by any first-order method to find an approximate solution to the problem. Furthermore, we present two near-optimal algorithms that can match the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. The first algorithm is a projected GD with a carefully designed stepsize schedule which incorporates warm-up and decay phases. The second algorithm is scalar-stepsize clipped AdamW which extends the near-optimal guarantees to the stochastic setting, where only a noisy unbiased estimator of the subgradient is available.

item.title: 提出无需训练的稀疏注意力框架PoCoAttn，将视频注意力分解为离线处理的输入稳定位置先验与在线处理的内容依赖残差，从而在大幅降低计算开销的同时实现快速且高保真的视频生成。
item.description:
PoCoAttn：面向快速高保真视频生成的位置-内容协同稀疏注意力

PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20307

提出无需训练的稀疏注意力框架PoCoAttn，将视频注意力分解为离线处理的输入稳定位置先验与在线处理的内容依赖残差，从而在大幅降低计算开销的同时实现快速且高保真的视频生成。

视频扩散Transformer依赖于对数万个时空token进行3D全注意力计算，其二次方开销主导了推理延迟。稀疏注意力可以降低这一成本，但现有方法面临两难困境：静态方法采用预定义掩码，无法捕捉依赖于输入的注意力；而动态方法需要反复在线重建稀疏掩码，为重新发现那些在不同输入之间基本稳定的位置结构付出了额外代价。为此，我们提出了PoCoAttn，这是一个无需训练的稀疏注意力框架，它将输入稳定型注意力与输入依赖型注意力分离开来，并分别通过离线和在线方式加以处理。PoCoAttn的特点包括：(1) 对3D查询-键对进行相对偏移分析，表明视频注意力可以分解为承载了大部分注意力权重的输入稳定位置先验，以及一个较小的内容依赖残差；(2) 一种位置-内容协同的稀疏注意力机制……（摘要原文在此处截断，后续内容缺失）

arXiv:2611.20307v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. item.title: 提出OntoCBF方法，将领域本体（含类分类体系、类型化关系、安全公理和动力学特征）编译为控制障碍函数安全过滤器，借助描述逻辑在线推理生成约束，并证明子类在能产生父类全部速度时可复用父类制动能力，从而解决异构机器人团队安全过滤中约束缺失、制动能力高估与约束冲突的问题。
item.description:
面向异构机器人团队的本体编译控制障碍函数

Ontology-Compiled Control Barrier Functions for Heterogeneous Robot Teams

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20306

提出OntoCBF方法，将领域本体（含类分类体系、类型化关系、安全公理和动力学特征）编译为控制障碍函数安全过滤器，借助描述逻辑在线推理生成约束，并证明子类在能产生父类全部速度时可复用父类制动能力，从而解决异构机器人团队安全过滤中约束缺失、制动能力高估与约束冲突的问题。

异构机器人团队的安全过滤器常常因为约束缺失、制动能力被高估以及各自可满足的约束之间发生冲突而失效。我们提出OntoCBF，它将一个包含类分类体系、类型化关系、安全公理以及每类机器人动力学特征信息的领域本体，编译为一个控制障碍函数（CBF）安全过滤器，其中每个智能体对应求解一个二次规划。描述逻辑推理可在线为任意团队生成约束，包括那些由关系链条以及由机器人所携带载荷定义的类所推出的约束，因此现有的安全公理能够覆盖新的机器人类、载荷类及其组合。我们证明，只要一个子类能够产生其父类的全部速度，它就可以复用父类的制动能力，这一性质独立于子类包含关系（subsumption）。对于箱式约束的双积分器，该性质也是必要的，且此时每一次安全性丧失都始于一个冲突（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.20306v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Safety filters for heterogeneous robot teams fail because of missing constraints, overestimated braking capabilities and conflicts between individually satisfiable constraints. We present OntoCBF, which compiles a domain ontology with a class taxonomy, typed relations, safety axioms and a dynamics profile per robot class into a control barrier function filter with one quadratic program per agent. Description-logic entailment supplies the constraints of any team online, including those that follow from chains of relations and from classes defined by what a robot carries, so the existing safety axioms cover new robot classes, payload classes and combinations. We prove that a subclass may reuse the braking capability of its parent whenever it can produce every velocity of the parent, a property separate from subsumption. For box-bounded double integrators this property is also necessary, and every loss of safety then begins with a conflic

item.title: 提出SP-EWC方法，通过将梯度投影到低秩安全子空间以捕获非对角曲率，从而在推理能力微调过程中高效保护大语言模型的安全行为。
item.description:
基于低秩Fisher正则化在推理训练中保护安全性

Protecting Safety during Reasoning Training with Low-Rank Fisher Regularisation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20288

提出SP-EWC方法，通过将梯度投影到低秩安全子空间以捕获非对角曲率，从而在推理能力微调过程中高效保护大语言模型的安全行为。

大语言模型经过训练具备安全防护机制，但在为推理等新能力进行微调时，这些机制可能被破坏。缓解这种安全性能退化的一种方法是修改微调目标以保留安全行为，但如何有效且高效地做到这一点仍然具有挑战性。我们重新审视了弹性权重整合（EWC）方法，该方法基于Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）对角线的敏感度估计来惩罚参数更新。虽然EWC提供了一定的保护，但对角近似忽略了参数之间的相互作用。我们通过利用近期关于安全相关行为位于模型内部低秩子空间的研究发现来解决这一局限。我们的方法——子空间投影弹性权重整合（SP-EWC）——将梯度投影到该子空间上，从而高效地捕获非对角曲率。我们研究了识别安全子空间的三种不同方法。

arXiv:2611.20288v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models are trained to have safety guardrails, but these can be compromised while fine-tuning for new capabilities, such as reasoning. One way to mitigate this degradation is to modify the fine-tuning objective to preserve safety behaviour, but doing so effectively and efficiently remains challenging. We revisit Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which penalises parameter updates based on sensitivity estimates from the diagonal of the Fisher information matrix (FIM). While EWC provides some protection, the diagonal approximation ignores interactions between parameters. We address this limitation by exploiting recent findings that safety-relevant behaviour is located in a low-rank subspace within models. Our method, Subspace-Projected Elastic Weight Consolidation (SP-EWC), projects gradients onto this subspace to capture non-diagonal curvature efficiently. We investigate three different ways of identifying the safety subs

item.title: 提出流形指数模型及MANOR算法，通过对相似响应的预测变量进行多尺度PCA估计切平面，使预测误差达到仅依赖流形内在维度 $m$ 的最优非参数速率 $n^{-4/(m+4)}$，可证明地克服了环境维度带来的维数灾难。
item.description:
流形指数模型：可证明且高效地避免统计与计算上的维数灾难

The Manifold-Index Model: provably and efficiently avoiding the statistical and computational curse of dimensionality

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20275

提出流形指数模型及MANOR算法，通过对相似响应的预测变量进行多尺度PCA估计切平面，使预测误差达到仅依赖流形内在维度 $m$ 的最优非参数速率 $n^{-4/(m+4)}$，可证明地克服了环境维度带来的维数灾难。

我们研究预测变量分布在 $\mathbb{R}^D$ 中未知 $m$ 维流形 $\mathcal{M}$ 周围管状区域内的向量值回归问题。在流形指数模型中，平均响应为 $F=f\circ\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$，其中 $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ 是到流形 $\mathcal{M}$ 的最近点投影，$f:\mathcal{M}\to\mathbb{R}^p$ 是一个可能非单射的连接函数。多尺度各向异性局部回归（MANOR）通过对具有相似响应的预测变量进行多尺度主成分分析（PCA）来估计切平面，然后通过汇集局部斜率的外积对其进行精细化，使邻域沿切向收缩的同时保留完整的法向纤维。我们假设连接函数的微分满足 Lipschitz 条件且响应噪声有界。当 $p\ge m$ 时，在我们的几何与采样条件下，$n$ 个独立观测可给出 $n^{-2/(m+4)}$ 阶的平均切空间误差，以及达到 $m$ 维非参数速率 $n^{-4/(m+4)}$ 的积分平方预测误差。

arXiv:2611.20275v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study vector-valued regression with predictors filling a tube around an unknown $m$-dimensional manifold $\mathcal{M}$ in $\mathbb{R}^D$. In the Manifold-Index Model, the mean response is $F=f\circ\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$, where $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ is the nearest-point projection onto $\mathcal{M}$ and $f:\mathcal{M}\to\mathbb{R}^p$ is a possibly non-injective link function. Multiscale ANisotropic lOcal Regression (MANOR) estimates tangent planes by multiscale PCA of predictors with similar responses, then refines them by pooling outer products of local slopes. The neighborhoods narrow tangentially while retaining complete normal fibers. We assume a Lipschitz link differential and bounded response noise. For $p\ge m$, under our geometric and sampling conditions, $n$ independent observations give mean tangent-space error of order $n^{-2/(m+4)}$ and integrated squared prediction error at the $m$-dimensional nonparametric rate $n^{-4/(m+4)}$

item.title: 本研究系统比较了多种自监督学习算法在斑马鱼胚胎表型分类任务上的表现，发现采用SwAV预训练的ResNet50表示仅需少量标签即可通过线性分类器达到86.4%的准确率，媲美全监督模型，并具备跨成像环境的迁移能力。
item.description:
面向斑马鱼胚胎表型评估的自监督学习：算法系统性比较、标签高效分类与迁移学习

Self-supervised learning for zebrafish embryo phenotype evaluation: Systematic comparison of algorithms, label-efficient classification, and transfer learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20269

本研究系统比较了多种自监督学习算法在斑马鱼胚胎表型分类任务上的表现，发现采用SwAV预训练的ResNet50表示仅需少量标签即可通过线性分类器达到86.4%的准确率，媲美全监督模型，并具备跨成像环境的迁移能力。

斑马鱼胚胎是基于图像表型分析的重要模式生物，尤其适用于大规模成像研究，机器学习（ML）模型可实现评估的自动化。然而，训练ML模型通常需要大量带标签的数据集，且成像条件的差异往往阻碍了模型在不同实验室之间的复用。自监督学习（SSL）通过从无标签图像中学习可迁移的表示，可以同时解决这两个限制。但对于特定领域的应用而言，算法选择等核心问题仍缺乏充分研究。为填补这一空白，我们在公开的EmbryoNet数据集上对流行的SSL算法进行了基准测试，探索了标签高效学习，并测试了模型向未见过的实验环境的迁移能力。使用我们最强模型（采用SwAV训练的ResNet50网络）所提取的表示，简单的线性分类器达到了86.4%的准确率，非线性分类器达到87.1%，可与全监督的EmbryoNet模型相媲美。

arXiv:2611.20269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Zebrafish embryos are a prominent model organism for image-based phenotyping and especially suited for large-scale imaging studies, for which machine learning (ML) models can automate evaluation. However, training ML models usually requires large labeled datasets, and differences in imaging conditions often impede reuse across laboratories. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses both constraints by learning transferable representations from unlabeled images. Yet central aspects like the choice of algorithm remain underexplored for domain-specific applications. To close this gap, we benchmark popular SSL algorithms on the public EmbryoNet dataset, explore label-efficient learning, and test transfer to an unseen setting. Using representations from our strongest model, a ResNet50 network trained with SwAV, a simple linear classifier reaches 86.4% accuracy and a non-linear classifier 87.1%, rivaling the fully supervised EmbryoNet model (

item.title: 该研究提出一种基于图神经网络的深度强化学习方法，利用利多岛40余年真实验潮记录训练策略，学习在极端水位（风暴潮）情境下选择市政应急行动的时机，实现了从数据到应急决策的关键一步。
item.description:
基于图神经网络的深度强化学习用于极端水位下的沿海应急响应

GNN-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Coastal Emergency Response under Extreme Water Levels

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20268

该研究提出一种基于图神经网络的深度强化学习方法，利用利多岛40余年真实验潮记录训练策略，学习在极端水位（风暴潮）情境下选择市政应急行动的时机，实现了从数据到应急决策的关键一步。

arXiv:2611.20268v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：当风暴潮逼近沿海城镇时，必须利用水位预报、洪水淹没范围、道路通行情况、弱势居民及避难所等信息，迅速启动应急预案。在时间压力下整合这些信息的过程既缓慢，又依赖于值班官员的个人经验。本文是从数据到安全决策这一更广泛研究路线中的一个环节：利用机器学习理解灾害，利用强化学习与规划来选择行动方案，利用大语言模型（LLM）对行动方案进行解释与交叉验证，并通过保障层确保人类始终掌控决策。本文聚焦于真实场景中的“行动”环节，探讨策略能否从数十年的真实事件中学习应急行动的时机。我们将威尼斯利多岛表示为一个异构图，该图由公开的高程、道路、建筑和人口普查数据构建，并由1983年至2024年的逐小时验潮仪记录驱动，包含取自市政应急计划的七种行动。

arXiv:2611.20268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When a storm surge approaches a coastal town, the emergency plan must be put into action quickly using water-level forecasts, flood extent, road access, vulnerable residents and shelters. Bringing this information together under time pressure is slow and depends on the duty officer's expertise. This paper is one step in a wider research line from data to safe decisions: machine learning to understand the hazard, reinforcement learning and planning to choose actions, large language models (LLMs) to explain and cross-check them, and an assurance layer that keeps people in charge. Here we address the action step on a real place. We ask whether a policy can learn the timing of emergency actions from decades of real events. item.title: 本研究提出一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）框架、结合GPT-BM25混合检索器的大语言模型方法，能够从医院价格透明度数据中准确估计门诊就诊价格，性能远超无RAG基线方法。
item.description:
使用大语言模型从医院价格透明度数据中估计门诊就诊价格

Estimating Outpatient Visit Prices from Hospital Price Transparency Data using Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20261

本研究提出一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）框架、结合GPT-BM25混合检索器的大语言模型方法，能够从医院价格透明度数据中准确估计门诊就诊价格，性能远超无RAG基线方法。

目标：美国的医院诊疗价格已大幅上涨，但患者缺乏有效工具来获取和比较费用。我们旨在开发和评估一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法，以改善医院价格透明度（PT）数据的获取和使用。材料与方法：为了估计就诊价格，我们使用检索增强生成（RAG）框架分析了马里兰州及周边地区三家主要医院的价格透明度文件。我们比较了BM25、OpenAI嵌入模型和GPT-BM25混合方法与无RAG基线在单个诊疗项目和诊疗项目组费用估计方面的表现，然后使用合成模拟评估了最佳方法在基于症状的就诊费用估计中的效果。结果：在各医院中，GPT-BM25检索器取得了最佳性能，单个诊疗项目的平均价格MAPE为19.44%，项目组为4.90%，而无RAG基线则分别为147.98%和82.82%。

arXiv:2611.20261v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Objective: Hospital care prices in the United States have increased substantially, yet patients lack effective tools to access and compare costs. We aimed to develop and evaluate an LLM-based approach for improving access to and use of hospital price transparency (PT) data. Materials and Methods: To estimate visit prices, we used a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework to analyze PT files from three major hospitals in Maryland and the surrounding region. We compared BM25, OpenAI embedding models, and a GPT-BM25 hybrid against a no-RAG baseline for cost estimation of individual procedures and procedure groups, then evaluated the best approach for symptom-based visit cost estimation using synthetic simulations. item.title: 提出证据校准选择（ECS），一种“人在回路”框架，通过从临床医生判定结果中推导置信度来自动识别需要人工审查的病例，从而实现大语言模型辅助治疗线判定的规模化应用。
item.description:
基于“人在回路”证据校准选择的大语言模型辅助治疗线判定规模化方法

Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20259

提出证据校准选择（ECS），一种“人在回路”框架，通过从临床医生判定结果中推导置信度来自动识别需要人工审查的病例，从而实现大语言模型辅助治疗线判定的规模化应用。

大语言模型（LLM）使以往依赖详尽人工审查的临床判定任务得以规模化。治疗线判定是肿瘤学队列构建中的主要瓶颈，是一个典型例子。治疗线边界必须依据细致且针对特定研究的定义，从纵向治疗史中推断得出，且需要对每个患者的每一次治疗方案转换进行判定。LLM能够大规模执行此类判定，但其可靠性因患者而异。治疗史的复杂程度各不相同，模糊或非典型的治疗模式则依赖于专家的临床判断。因此，可靠的自动化需要为模型判定结果提供经过验证的支持，并具备识别需要人工审查病例的能力。本文提出了证据校准选择（ECS），这是一种用于规模化LLM辅助治疗线判定的“人在回路”框架。ECS从观察到的临床医生判定结果和先验（摘要在此处截断）中推导置信度……

arXiv:2611.20259v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prior

item.title: 微拟合通过为每个文档离线训练并缓存一个小型适配器，以参数隔离的方式规避灾难性遗忘，使语言模型能够持续学习新数据而不覆盖旧知识。
item.description:
微拟合：通过缓存的测试时训练实现持续学习

Microfitting: Continual Learning via Cached Test-Time Training

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20258

微拟合通过为每个文档离线训练并缓存一个小型适配器，以参数隔离的方式规避灾难性遗忘，使语言模型能够持续学习新数据而不覆盖旧知识。

持续学习是一种将语言模型专门化以适配组织私有数据的有前景的方法。然而，现有方法存在诸多缺陷，包括灾难性遗忘——即新的训练更新会覆盖先前的知识。我们提出了微拟合（microfitting），即为每个文档训练并缓存一个小型适配器。每个适配器仅在离线状态下针对已证实的基座模型缺陷所生成的合成问题训练一次，并在该文档被查询时重复使用。该方法借鉴了测试时学习的相关文献，通过参数隔离规避了持续学习的问题，使系统能够在专门化适配新数据的同时不覆盖先前知识。生成适配器训练数据的过程也会随时间不断改进，根据以往的结果和目标工作负载的新样本来修订其配方。在 DeepSeek V4 Flash 上，微拟合相比基座模型大幅提升了准确率。

arXiv:2611.20258v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual learning is a promising approach to specialize language models to an organization's private data. However, current methods exhibit a number of drawbacks including catastrophic forgetting, where new training updates overwrite prior knowledge. We present microfitting, which trains and caches a small adapter for each document. Each adapter is trained once, offline, on synthetic questions targeted at demonstrated base-model shortcomings and reused whenever that document is queried. This method borrows from test-time learning literature and sidesteps the problem of continual learning through parameter isolation, allowing the system to specialize on new data without overwriting prior knowledge. The process that generates adapter training data also improves over time, revising its recipe from previous outcomes and fresh examples of the target workload. On DeepSeek V4 Flash, microfitting substantially improves accuracy over the base

item.title: 本文提出了一个调整代价为 O(ε^{-2}) 的算法，在元素在线到达的设定下以 1/4−ε 的近似比解决基数约束下的非单调次模函数最大化问题，并证明 1/4 是常数调整代价算法的紧致上界。
item.description:
常数调整代价下基数约束非单调次模函数最大化的紧致界

Tight Bounds for Non-Monotone Submodular Maximization under a Cardinality Constraint with Constant Recourse

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20257

本文提出了一个调整代价为 O(ε^{-2}) 的算法，在元素在线到达的设定下以 1/4−ε 的近似比解决基数约束下的非单调次模函数最大化问题，并证明 1/4 是常数调整代价算法的紧致上界。

我们研究在基数约束下最大化非负次模函数的问题，其中元素逐个到达，且算法必须在每次元素到达后报告一个可行集合。算法的调整代价是指它在单次元素到达时对所报告集合进行的插入和删除操作的最大次数。对于任意 ε>0，我们提出了一个调整代价为 O(ε^{-2}) 的算法，其报告的集合在任意时刻的期望值至少是已到达元素中最大可行集值的 1/4−ε 倍。该算法对函数进行多项式次数的求值，且仅对已到达元素构成的集合进行求值。我们还证明了任何具有常数调整代价的算法都无法取得高于 1/4 的近似比，即使该算法事先知晓函数和元素到达顺序并拥有无限的计算能力；此外，要达到任何固定的高于 1/4 的比率，所需的调整代价必须随基数预算呈正数次幂增长。因此 1/4 是该问题的紧致界。

arXiv:2611.20257v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the maximization of a nonnegative submodular function under a cardinality constraint when elements arrive one at a time and an algorithm must report a feasible set after every arrival. The recourse of an algorithm is the largest number of insertions and deletions that it makes to the reported set at a single arrival. For every $\epsilon>0$, we give an algorithm with recourse $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ whose reported set has, at every time, expected value at least $1/4-\epsilon$ times the largest value of a feasible set of arrived elements. The algorithm evaluates the function polynomially often, and only on sets of arrived elements. We also show that no algorithm with constant recourse achieves a ratio above $1/4$, even if it knows the function and the arrival order in advance and has unlimited computation, and that any fixed ratio above $1/4$ requires recourse that grows as a positive power of the cardinality budget. Thus $1/4$ is th

item.title: LBM-VAE通过将潜在块模型集成到变分自编码器中，利用块结构的潜在表示实现观测数据与潜在维度的联合聚类，并允许变化因素跨潜在维度组编码，从而有效支持解耦表示学习。
item.description:
将潜在块模型集成到变分自编码器中以实现解耦表示学习

Integrating Latent Block Models into Variational Autoencoders for Disentangled Representation Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20253

LBM-VAE通过将潜在块模型集成到变分自编码器中，利用块结构的潜在表示实现观测数据与潜在维度的联合聚类，并允许变化因素跨潜在维度组编码，从而有效支持解耦表示学习。

我们提出了LBM-VAE，这是一个将潜在块模型集成到变分自编码器中以联合对观测数据和潜在维度进行聚类的新型框架。除了聚类能力之外，LBM-VAE还提供了一种块结构的潜在表示，天然支持解耦表示学习。与传统方法将每个变化因素与单个潜在维度相关联不同，我们的框架允许变化因素在潜在维度组上进行编码。实验结果证明了LBM-VAE具有出色的聚类性能，同时在解耦表示学习方面取得了具有竞争力的结果。LBM-VAE凸显了将协同聚类与变分推断相结合以学习结构化和可解释潜在表示的潜力。

arXiv:2611.20253v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce LBM-VAE, a novel framework that integrates Latent Block Models (LBMs) into Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) to jointly cluster observations and latent dimensions. Beyond its clustering capabilities, LBM-VAE provides a block-structured latent representation that naturally supports disentangled representation learning. In contrast to conventional approaches that associate each factor of variation with an individual latent dimension, our framework allows factors of variation to be encoded across groups of latent dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate the promising clustering performance of LBM-VAE, while achieving competitive results in disentangled representation learning. LBM-VAE highlights the potential of combining co-clustering and variational inference to learn structured and interpretable latent representations.

item.title: TileCache是一个面向多轮扩散图像编辑的服务系统，它通过压缩可重用激活来构建高效缓存，并设计压缩感知的调度器以平衡初始生成与缓存编辑请求，解决了中间激活缓存带来的内存开销与调度难题。
item.description:
TileCache：基于压缩激活缓存的多轮扩散图像编辑服务系统

TileCache: Serving Multi-Round Diffusion Image Editing with Compressed Activation Caches

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20246

TileCache是一个面向多轮扩散图像编辑的服务系统，它通过压缩可重用激活来构建高效缓存，并设计压缩感知的调度器以平衡初始生成与缓存编辑请求，解决了中间激活缓存带来的内存开销与调度难题。

多轮扩散图像编辑可以通过重用中间激活来减少计算量，但跨编辑轮次保留这些激活会引入大量的内存和带宽开销。压缩虽然可以减少这些开销，但高效的缓存构建充满挑战：如果仅在编辑完成后才进行压缩，则需要为每个请求缓冲超过100 GB的激活。此外，压缩后的缓存必须支持选择性重用，因为未来的掩码编辑只需要缓存激活中的一个子集。这还带来了调度方面的挑战：由于缓存编辑比初始生成更快，简单的调度策略会严重延迟初始生成请求或编辑请求。在本文中，我们旨在通过压缩感知的服务方式来应对这两个挑战。我们开发了TileCache，一个面向多轮扩散图像编辑的服务系统。它对可重用的激活进行压缩，并引入了一个能够在编辑请求之间实现平衡的调度器。

arXiv:2611.20246v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-round diffusion image editing can reduce computation by reusing intermediate activations, but retaining these activations across editing rounds introduces substantial memory and bandwidth overheads. Compression can reduce these overheads, but efficient cache construction is challenging: compressing only after editing requires buffering over 100 GB of activations per request. Moreover, the compressed cache must support selective reuse, as future masked edits require only a subset of the cached activations. It also exposes a scheduling challenge, as cached edits are faster than initial generations, causing naive policies to severely delay either initial generations or editing requests. In this paper, we aim to address both challenges through compression-informed serving. We develop TileCache, a serving system for multi-round diffusion editing. It compresses reusable activations and incorporates a scheduler that balances both edits

item.title: 提出ReGround推理时方法，通过任务无关的电机乱动学习部署机器人的动力学来重新锚定冻结VLA模型的预期运动，无需奖励、演示或重新训练即可应对执行机构偏移，显著恢复任务成功率（如400ms延迟下π0.5成功率从0.16提升至0.90）。
item.description:
目标正确，本体错误：执行机构偏移下冻结VLA模型的重新锚定

Right Goal, Wrong Body: Re-grounding Frozen VLAs under Actuation Shift

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20244

提出ReGround推理时方法，通过任务无关的电机乱动学习部署机器人的动力学来重新锚定冻结VLA模型的预期运动，无需奖励、演示或重新训练即可应对执行机构偏移，显著恢复任务成功率（如400ms延迟下π0.5成功率从0.16提升至0.90）。

视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在理想环境下产生期望的机器人行为。然而，当部署时机器人的执行机构发生变化，它们往往会失败。例如，重新安装、机械磨损或指令延迟变化可能导致任务失败和不安全行为。为了应对不可避免的执行机构偏移，我们提出了ReGround，一种推理时方法，它保持VLA模型冻结并重新锚定其预期运动。ReGround通过任务无关的电机乱动学习已部署机器人的动力学，然后在跟踪策略预期运动的同时保持接近策略自身的规划。ReGround仅在检测到偏移时激活，无需奖励、演示或重新训练。我们通过两个VLA、八个LIBERO任务和五种偏移设置表明，ReGround能够恢复接近最优的成功率，例如在400毫秒延迟下将π0.5的成功率从0.16提升至0.90，同时比线性补偿方法更安全。

arXiv:2611.20244v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. item.title: 该论文提出了雷达全景Transformer（RPT），通过语义引导的掩码查询和雷达自适应特征提取，在稀疏雷达点云上实现无需几何聚类的端到端全景分割，从而更好地理解动态场景。
item.description:
雷达全景Transformer：面向动态场景理解的语义引导掩码查询

Radar Panoptic Transformer: Semantic-Guided Mask Queries for Dynamic Scene Understanding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20203

该论文提出了雷达全景Transformer（RPT），通过语义引导的掩码查询和雷达自适应特征提取，在稀疏雷达点云上实现无需几何聚类的端到端全景分割，从而更好地理解动态场景。

汽车雷达能够提供远距离感知和直接的多普勒速度测量，但其稀疏且非均匀采样的点云为全景分割带来了重大挑战。动态目标往往在占主导地位的静态背景中仅产生少量检测点，这限制了用于分离目标实例的几何线索。我们提出了雷达全景Transformer（RPT），这是一种端到端的基于点的网络，将雷达自适应特征提取与语义引导的掩码预测相结合。其骨干网络通过分组向量注意力聚合姿态对齐的时序上下文，并根据距离、方位角和雷达散射截面（RCS）学习每个点的邻域半径。逐点语义预测在可能的前景检测处初始化查询，并通过查询与点之间的类别一致性引导掩码交叉注意力，从而在无需几何聚类的情况下生成实例掩码。辅助的RCS一致性……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.20203v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automotive radar provides long-range sensing and direct Doppler velocity measurements, but its sparse and non-uniformly sampled point clouds pose significant challenges for panoptic segmentation. Dynamic objects often yield only a few detections amid a dominant static background, providing limiting the geometric cues for separating object instances. We propose \emph{Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT)}, an end-to-end point-based network that incorporates radar-adaptive feature extraction with semantic-guided mask prediction. Its backbone aggregates pose-aligned temporal context through grouped vector attention and learns per-point neighborhood radii conditioned on range, azimuth, and radar cross section (RCS). Point-wise semantic predictions initialize queries at likely foreground detections and guide masked cross-attention through query-point class agreement, producing instance masks without geometric clustering. item.title: 该论文提出了一种自由度查询Transformer融合解码器，通过为每个关节自由度分配独立的可学习查询来自适应融合自我中心视觉与前臂高密度表面肌电信号的互补信息，实现无需束缚手指的连续手部关节角度精准估计。
item.description:
用于连续手部运动学估计的自由度查询Transformer：自我中心视觉与前臂高密度表面肌电信号的自适应融合

DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20196

该论文提出了一种自由度查询Transformer融合解码器，通过为每个关节自由度分配独立的可学习查询来自适应融合自我中心视觉与前臂高密度表面肌电信号的互补信息，实现无需束缚手指的连续手部关节角度精准估计。

连续且准确地估计人体手部运动学不仅对直观的人机交互非常重要，而且对于捕获细粒度的人类操作示范也至关重要，这些示范可以为具身智能数据集和灵巧机器人学习提供动作监督。然而，在变化的运行条件下，单一传感模态可能不足以实现可靠估计。我们提出了一种不束缚手指的多模态框架，用于从自我中心RGB图像和128通道前臂高密度表面肌电信号连续回归20个手部关节角度。该框架结合了基于Vision Transformer的视觉编码器、基于Transformer的肌电编码器以及自由度查询Transformer融合解码器。为了考虑视觉和肌电线索在不同关节自由度和输入条件下信息量的差异，解码器为每个自由度分配一个独立的可学习查询……

arXiv:2611.20196v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. item.title: CAPSARII项目提出了一个集成智能织物传感、安全RISC-V边缘AI和云端/联邦分析的网络安全超低功耗可穿戴平台与战场物联网架构，用于士兵健康实时监测，并在压力分类基准测试中取得了先进性能。
item.description:
面向士兵健康监测的网络安全的可穿戴超低功耗网络化传感器：来自CAPSARII项目的见解

Cyber-Secure Wearable, Ultra-Low-Power Networked Sensors for Soldier Health Monitoring: Insights from the CAPSARII project

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20187

CAPSARII项目提出了一个集成智能织物传感、安全RISC-V边缘AI和云端/联邦分析的网络安全超低功耗可穿戴平台与战场物联网架构，用于士兵健康实时监测，并在压力分类基准测试中取得了先进性能。

CAPSARII项目推进了一个网络安全、超低功耗的可穿戴平台和战场物联网框架，以支持对军事人员的实时监测和数据驱动的决策支持。该架构集成了智能织物传感、身体/小队区域网格网络、部署在安全RISC-V微控制器上的边缘AI，以及用于跨任务学习和对比研究的云端/联邦分析。两个代表性用例——飞行员疲劳以及在恶劣环境中作战的士兵——指导了系统的需求、验证和界面设计（包括平视显示器和触觉反馈）。作为迈向嵌入式模型的初步步骤，我们在公开的可穿戴数据集上对压力分类进行了基准测试：树集成基线模型在准确率和F1分数方面达到了最先进的性能（例如，XGBoost：准确率=0.901±0.023，F1=0.920±0.019），而基于特征的Transformer则获得了最高的AUC。

arXiv:2611.20187v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The CAPSARII project advances a cyber-secure, ultra-low-power wearable platform and Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) framework to support real-time monitoring of military personnel and data-driven decision support. The architecture integrates smart-textile sensing, a body/squad area mesh, edge-deployed AI on secure RISC-V microcontrollers, and cloud/federated analytics for cross-mission learning and comparative studies. Two representative use cases--pilot fatigue and warfighters operating in harsh environments--guide requirements, validation, and interface design (including HUD and haptic feedback). As an initial step toward embedded models, we benchmark stress classification on a public wearable dataset: tree-ensemble baselines achieve state-of-the-art performance for accuracy and F1 (e.g., XGBoost: $\mathrm{Accuracy}=0.901\!\pm\!0.023$, $\mathrm{F1}=0.920\!\pm\!0.019$), while a feature-based Transformer attains the highest AUC

item.title: RoboKit是一个高性能的机器人并行可微优化工具包，通过GPU并行多种子求解器、混合几何表示和与学习的深度集成，实现比任务专用基线快2-60倍的优化速度，并能将优化蒸馏为快9-240倍的策略或加速强化学习训练。
item.description:
RoboKit：加速机器人学习的并行可微优化

RoboKit: Accelerating Parallel Differentiable Optimization for Robot Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20185

RoboKit是一个高性能的机器人并行可微优化工具包，通过GPU并行多种子求解器、混合几何表示和与学习的深度集成，实现比任务专用基线快2-60倍的优化速度，并能将优化蒸馏为快9-240倍的策略或加速强化学习训练。

我们提出了RoboKit，一个面向机器人领域的高性能、通用型并行可微优化工具包，它建立在三大原则之上：(i) 性能与灵活性：GPU并行的多随机种子求解器将采样与多种通用优化器相结合，在七个任务中比任务专用基线快2-60倍；(ii) 几何、渲染与物理：混合表示和由粗到细的表示方法加速了碰撞检测、可微渲染和仿真，可在2.97秒内优化4096个抓取；(iii) 与学习的集成：代价函数可微且仿真支持并行，因此RoboKit既可以将优化结果蒸馏为策略，也可以训练强化学习；蒸馏出的策略在相当精度下运行速度快9-240倍，而强化学习在同一仿真器上最多可比GPU基线提前2.1倍达到相同分数。

arXiv:2611.20185v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present RoboKit, a high-performance, general-purpose toolkit for parallel differentiable optimization in robotics, built on three principles: (i) Performance and flexibility: GPU-parallel multi-seed solvers pair sampling with versatile optimizers, running 2-60$\times$ faster than task-specific baselines across seven tasks; (ii) Geometry, rendering and physics: hybrid and coarse-to-fine representations accelerate collision, differentiable rendering and simulation, optimizing 4096 grasps in 2.97 s; (iii) Integration with learning: costs are differentiable and simulation is parallel, so RoboKit both distills optimization into policies and trains RL; distilled policies run 9-240$\times$ faster at comparable accuracy, and RL reaches a GPU baseline's scores up to 2.1$\times$ sooner on the same simulator.

item.title: 本文首次提出“POI入驻下的区域ROI预测”这一新研究问题，并设计了干预感知的因果预测框架UrbanROI，通过建模ROI时间演化与周边POI间的竞争交互，实现对新POI入驻后区域经济回报走势的准确预测。
item.description:
UrbanROI：面向POI入驻场景的区域ROI预测因果建模

UrbanROI: Causal Modeling for Regional ROI Forecasting under POI Entry

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20180

本文首次提出“POI入驻下的区域ROI预测”这一新研究问题，并设计了干预感知的因果预测框架UrbanROI，通过建模ROI时间演化与周边POI间的竞争交互，实现对新POI入驻后区域经济回报走势的准确预测。

随着城市商业环境的持续快速演变，准确建模兴趣点（POI）入驻的经济影响，对于支持数据驱动的广告投放分配、商户入驻引导以及区域商业决策至关重要。现有的投资回报率（ROI）预测方法主要聚焦于单个广告或商户，忽视了POI之间的交互效应，也未能捕捉城市商业生态系统中结构性变化所带来的因果影响。在本文中，我们提出了一个新颖的研究问题——POI入驻下的区域ROI预测，旨在通过建模ROI的时间演化以及周边POI之间由竞争驱动的相互作用，预测新POI入驻后商业区域未来的ROI变化轨迹。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了UrbanROI，一个面向区域级经济结果预测的、具备干预感知能力的因果预测框架。

arXiv:2611.20180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As urban commercial environments continue to evolve rapidly, accurately modeling the economic impact of point of interest (POI) entry is essential for supporting data-driven advertising allocation, merchant onboarding, and regional business decision-making. Existing return on investment (ROI) prediction methods mainly focus on individual ads or merchants, overlooking the interaction effects among POIs and failing to capture the causal influence of structural changes in urban commercial ecosystems. In this paper, we introduce a novel research problem -- regional ROI forecasting under POI entry, which aims to predict the future ROI trajectory of a commercial region after the introduction of a new POI by modeling temporal ROI evolution and competition-driven interactions among surrounding POIs. To address these challenges, we propose UrbanROI, an intervention-aware causal forecasting framework for region-level economic outcome prediction. U

item.title: 该论文证明了在 $p>2$ 的 $\ell_p$ 范数下估计重尾随机向量均值时，即使期望风险也需要稳健化，极小极大风险随样本量、维度和范数参数呈现尖锐相变，且简单的坐标式中位数均值估计器即可达到最优速率。
item.description:
重尾分布均值估计在 $\ell_p$ 范数下的相变现象

Phase Transitions in Heavy-Tailed Mean Estimation under $\ell_p$ Norms

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20176

该论文证明了在 $p>2$ 的 $\ell_p$ 范数下估计重尾随机向量均值时，即使期望风险也需要稳健化，极小极大风险随样本量、维度和范数参数呈现尖锐相变，且简单的坐标式中位数均值估计器即可达到最优速率。

我们研究在 $\ell_p$ 范数下估计 $\mathbb R^d$ 中随机向量均值的问题，仅假设协方差矩阵存在。在欧几里得范数下，样本均值在期望意义上已经是最优的，稳健估计器通常只有在需要高概率尾界时才被需要。我们的结果表明，对于 $p>2$ 的 $\ell_p$ 范数，这一图景发生了改变：即使对于期望风险，稳健化也已经是必要的。我们证明了极小极大风险呈现出一个尖锐的相变，该相变由样本量 $n$、维度 $d$ 和范数参数 $p$ 之间的相互作用所控制。在大样本情形下，经典的高斯速率仍然可以实现；而在互补的情形下，重尾分布造成了真正的非高斯障碍。此外，我们证明了一个简单的估计器——坐标式中位数均值（其桶数根据损失的几何结构来选取）能够最优地……

arXiv:2611.20176v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the problem of estimating the mean of a random vector in $\mathbb R^d$ under $\ell_p$ norms, assuming only the existence of a covariance matrix. In the Euclidean norm, the sample mean is already optimal in expectation, and robust estimators are usually needed only to obtain high-probability tails. Our results show that this picture changes for $\ell_p$ norms with $p>2$: robustification is already necessary even for the expected risk. We prove that the minimax risk exhibits a sharp phase transition, controlled by the interaction between the sample size $n$, the dimension $d$, and the norm parameter $p$. In the large-sample regime, the classical Gaussian rate remains achievable. In the complementary regime, heavy-tailed distributions create a genuinely non-Gaussian obstruction. item.title: 大语言模型 GPT-6 Astra 无需梯度优化即可直接对表格基础模型的权重进行编程，既能从零构建接近预训练基线性能的表格预测模型，也能诊断并修复预训练模型中的缺陷。
item.description:
权重与缓存：大语言模型能够对表格基础模型进行编程

Weights & Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20174

大语言模型 GPT-6 Astra 无需梯度优化即可直接对表格基础模型的权重进行编程，既能从零构建接近预训练基线性能的表格预测模型，也能诊断并修复预训练模型中的缺陷。

神经网络通常是通过优化过程来“编程”的，而不是通过显式指定其计算方式。近期关于权重空间编程的研究表明，大语言模型（LLMs）可以直接对神经网络的权重进行推理和操作。在这项工作中，我们证明大语言模型可以直接对表格基础模型（TFMs）中的统计计算进行编程，此类模型的参数支持跨不同数据集的推理。我们使用 GPT-6 Astra 研究了三种互补的设置，且不依赖基于梯度的优化。首先，Astra 从零初始化的权重出发直接对 nanoTabPFN 进行编程，在 20 个 TabArena 数据集上取得了 0.849 的平均 ROC AUC，而预训练基线为 0.876。其次，Astra 诊断并修复了预训练 TabPFN-3.5 中符号乘积回归的失败问题，在留出的合成数据集上恢复了近乎完美的预测，同时保持了在 TabArena-Lite 上的性能……

arXiv:2611.20174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks are typically programmed through optimization, rather than by explicitly specifying their computations. Recent work on weight-space programming suggests that large language models (LLMs) can instead reason about and manipulate neural-network weights directly. In this work, we show that LLMs can directly program statistical computations in tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose parameters enable inference across different datasets. We investigate three complementary settings using GPT-6 Astra, without gradient-based optimization. First, Astra directly programs nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights, achieving a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, compared to 0.876 for a pretrained baseline. item.title: 该论文提出以跨被试群体模型的期望统计量作为共轭先验的LSIM最大后验估计方法，在少试次运动想象脑电中保持闭式M步与单调收敛，并显著优于传统的最大似然估计。

面向少试次运动想象脑电的潜在结构影响模型最大后验估计的跨被试先验方法

Cross-Subject Priors for Maximum a Posteriori Estimation of Latent Structure Influence Models in Motor-Imagery EEG With Few Trials

该论文提出以跨被试群体模型的期望统计量作为共轭先验的LSIM最大后验估计方法，在少试次运动想象脑电中保持闭式M步与单调收敛，并显著优于传统的最大似然估计。

耦合隐马尔可夫模型（如潜在结构影响模型，LSIM）能够描述运动想象过程中两个大脑半球的感觉运动节律如何演化并相互作用，但当可用试次较少时，针对单个被试的最大似然（ML）估计是不稳定的。本文推导了LSIM的最大后验（MAP）估计器，其共轭先验等于基于其他被试拟合的群体模型所生成的λ个伪试次的期望统计量。该方法的M步仍保持闭式解，期望最大化算法保持单调上升特性，且ML估计（λ=0）和群体模型（λ→∞）是其两个极限情形。先验强度在PhysioNet脑电运动/想象数据集的35名被试上进行选择，并原封不动地应用于70名留出被试以及BCI Competition IV-2a数据集。当λ=1时，留出被试的对数似然在70名被试中有61名超过了ML估计（经Holm校正p=9.1×10^……（原文截断）

arXiv:2611.20164v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coupled hidden Markov models such as the latent structure influence model (LSIM) describe how the sensorimotor rhythms of the two hemispheres evolve and interact during motor imagery, but subject-specific maximum likelihood (ML) estimates are unstable when few trials are available. This paper derives a maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimator for the LSIM whose conjugate prior equals the expected statistics of $\lambda$ pseudo-trials from a population model fitted to other subjects. The M-step remains in closed form, expectation maximization keeps its monotone ascent, and ML ($\lambda=0$) and the population model ($\lambda\to\infty$) are limiting cases. The prior strength was selected on 35 subjects of the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset and applied unchanged to 70 held-out subjects and to BCI Competition IV-2a. item.title: 该论文提出KINDy方法，先利用核岭回归确定各分量的多项式次数以缩减候选函数库，再应用稀疏回归，从而学习含非多项式非线性的动力系统的提升稀疏多项式模型，避免了多项式次数未知时稀疏回归所需的组合爆炸式大型函数库。
item.description:
非线性动力系统提升稀疏多项式模型的核引导学习

Kernel-Guided Learning of Lifted Sparse Polynomial Models of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20157

该论文提出KINDy方法，先利用核岭回归确定各分量的多项式次数以缩减候选函数库，再应用稀疏回归，从而学习含非多项式非线性的动力系统的提升稀疏多项式模型，避免了多项式次数未知时稀疏回归所需的组合爆炸式大型函数库。

动力系统的多项式模型可以通过平方和规划实现构造性分析。然而，许多物理系统涉及非多项式非线性，对于某些类别的系统，即使在精确动力学未知的情况下，也可以从其底层物理规律中推断出这些非线性项。我们证明，直接将提升的多项式模型拟合到提升的数据上是有问题的，因为精确的提升约束会导致提升后的导数线性相关。相反，我们在扩展状态（即系统状态与已知非线性项的组合）中学习动力学，并通过精确的提升关系获得非线性项的动力学。为了避免在多项式次数未知时稀疏回归所需的组合爆炸式的大型候选函数库，我们提出了KINDy方法，该方法先通过核岭回归选择每个分量的多项式次数，再对相应缩减后的函数库应用稀疏回归。我们证明，对于……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.20157v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Polynomial models of dynamical systems enable constructive analysis via sum-of-squares programming. Yet, many physical systems involve non-polynomial nonlinearities which for certain classes of systems may be inferred from the underlying physics even when the exact dynamics are unknown. We show that fitting lifted polynomial models directly to lifted data is problematic, since the exact lifting constraints render the lifted derivatives linearly dependent. Instead, we learn the dynamics in the extended state, i.e., the state together with the known nonlinearities, and obtain the dynamics of the nonlinearities via the exact lifting relations. To avoid the combinatorially large libraries that sparse regression requires when the polynomial degrees are unknown, we propose KINDy, which selects the degree of each component by kernel ridge regression before applying sparse regression to the correspondingly reduced library. item.title: 本文将LLM裁判护栏的系统提示词选择建模为带有限样本风险认证的约束优化问题，提出CPS和CRISP两种方法，在统计保证漏检攻击率不超过用户指定阈值α的前提下最大化良性通过率。
item.description:
面向LLM-as-a-judge安全护栏的风险认证提示词优化

Risk-certified prompt optimization for LLM-as-a-judge guardrails

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20156

本文将LLM裁判护栏的系统提示词选择建模为带有限样本风险认证的约束优化问题，提出CPS和CRISP两种方法，在统计保证漏检攻击率不超过用户指定阈值α的前提下最大化良性通过率。

LLM-as-a-judge（大语言模型作为裁判）安全护栏通常主要通过系统提示词来控制，然而标准的提示词优化方法针对的是平均性能而非显式的安全约束。本文将系统提示词的选择问题建模为一个约束优化问题：在保证漏检攻击率低于用户指定水平α的同时，最大化良性通过率，并提供有限样本统计控制。该框架结合了基于LLM的评判、自动提示词生成和无分布风险认证。这项工作将该框架具体化为两种流程：CPS和CRISP。CPS从训练数据中生成固定的提示词池，然后使用同步置信上界在留出的评估集上对候选提示词进行风险认证，并选择认证通过且良性效用最高的提示词。CRISP则将风险反馈整合到自适应搜索中，利用难例引导的提示词重写和可复用的留出集接口来引导……

arXiv:2611.20156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge guardrails are often controlled primarily through system prompts, yet standard prompt optimization methods target average performance rather than explicit safety constraints. This paper studies system-prompt selection as a constrained optimization problem: maximize benign pass rate while keeping the missed-attack rate below a user-specified level {\alpha} with finite-sample statistical control. The framework combines LLM-based judging, automatic prompt generation, and distribution-free risk certification. This work instantiates it in two procedures: CPS and CRISP. CPS generates a fixed pool of prompts from training data, then certifies candidates on a held-out evaluation set using simultaneous upper confidence bounds and selects the certified prompt with the highest benign utility. CRISP instead integrates risk feedback into an adaptive search, using hard example-guided rewriting and a reusable-holdout interface to steer g

item.title: 该论文提出一种“软等变”神经网络架构，可在训练中自动只对与数据相关的对称群保持等变，并能通过检查网络获得一个“对称性指纹”，确切揭示哪些对称性相关及其相关程度。
item.description:
基于几何可学习不变量Transformer的对称性指纹识别

Symmetry Fingerprinting with Geometric Learnable Invariants Transformers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20150

该论文提出一种“软等变”神经网络架构，可在训练中自动只对与数据相关的对称群保持等变，并能通过检查网络获得一个“对称性指纹”，确切揭示哪些对称性相关及其相关程度。

几何深度学习已经提供了大量结构等变的神经网络架构，即输入的某种特定变换会引起输出的可预测变换。但结构等变性是一种非常强的归纳偏置，如果选择不当可能会限制性能。相比之下，选择几何偏置较低的架构则需要通过数据增强来获得正确的行为，从而延长训练过程。我们提出了一种新颖的软等变神经网络架构：我们选定一组对称群，在训练过程中，网络将仅对那些在给定训练数据下合适的对称群变得等变。训练完成后，我们可以检查该网络以获得一个对称性指纹，它会确切地告诉我们哪些对称性最终是相关的，以及相关的程度有多大。我们展示了我们的架构和指纹识别过程如何在相关任务中工作。

arXiv:2611.20150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometric deep learning has made available a large variety of structurally equivariant neural network architectures, meaning a particular transformation of their input causes a predictable transformation of their output. But structural equivariance is a very strong inductive bias that can limit performance if chosen poorly. In contrast, choosing an architecture with low geometric bias necessitates data augmentation to obtain correct behavior; extending the training process. We propose a novel neural network architecture that is soft equivariant; we select a set of symmetry groups and during training the network will become equivariant only to those symmetry groups that are appropriate given the training data. After training we can inspect the network to obtain a symmetry fingerprint that will tell us exactly which symmetries ended up being relevant and to what degree. item.title: 提出Cleanly-DINO方法，可从少量演示中高效学习视觉任务空间，能够定位未完成任务区域并跨视觉域迁移，还可作为强化学习的观测编码器和奖励信号，已成功部署于真实机器人擦拭任务中。
item.description:
Cleanly-DINO：为机器人技术高效学习视觉任务空间

Cleanly-DINO: Efficiently Learning Visual Task Spaces for Robotics

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20137

提出Cleanly-DINO方法，可从少量演示中高效学习视觉任务空间，能够定位未完成任务区域并跨视觉域迁移，还可作为强化学习的观测编码器和奖励信号，已成功部署于真实机器人擦拭任务中。

从少量演示中学习操作任务需要能够捕捉与任务完成相关变化的抽象表示，例如刚体操作中的物体位姿。然而，诸如清洁之类的任务是由视觉状态的变化而非物体位姿来定义的，这使得任务表示的选择变得不那么明确。在本工作中，我们提出Cleanly-DINO，用于从少量演示中学习视觉任务空间。给定任务相关区域的掩码和冻结的ViT特征，Cleanly-DINO拟合一个投影来隔离出任务空间，并为其拟合一个进度度量。我们在多样化的清洁示例上训练该模型，并评估其定位未完成任务区域以及跨视觉域迁移的能力。我们还研究了它在机器人学习中的实用性，将其用作强化学习设置中的观测编码器和奖励信号。最后，我们将拟合好的模型部署到真实世界的机器人擦拭流程中进行评估。

arXiv:2611.20137v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning manipulation tasks from few demonstrations requires abstractions that capture the changes relevant to task completion, such as object poses in rigid-body manipulation. However, tasks such as cleaning are defined by changes in visual state rather than object pose, making the choice of task representation less clear. In this work, we propose Cleanly-DINO to learn visual task spaces from few demonstrations. Given a mask of a task-relevant region and frozen ViT features, Cleanly-DINO fits a projection to isolate a task space and fit a progression metric to it. We train the model on diverse cleaning examples and evaluate its ability to localize incomplete task regions and transfer across visual domains. We also study its utility for robot learning by using it as an observation encoder and reward signal in a reinforcement learning setting. Finally, we deploy our fitted model within a real-world robotic wiping pipeline to evaluate it

item.title: 该研究首次在临床文本上评估决策模型，发现 Tev1 从口腔癌病理报告中提取 25 个字段的准确率（0.917）与生成式模型相当且速度快四倍，但在分箱测量值和答案未明确表述的字段上表现较弱。
item.description:
决策模型能否从癌症病理报告中提取临床数据？对准确性、校准与失败模式的评估

Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20129

该研究首次在临床文本上评估决策模型，发现 Tev1 从口腔癌病理报告中提取 25 个字段的准确率（0.917）与生成式模型相当且速度快四倍，但在分箱测量值和答案未明确表述的字段上表现较弱。

决策模型是一类新型语言模型，它不生成文本，而是针对每个问题从固定选项列表中选择一个选项，并为每个选项返回一个概率。此前这类模型尚未在临床文本上得到评估。我们评估了两个开放权重的决策模型——Nimble 9B 和 Tev1 4B——从单一中心的 1,113 份口腔癌病理报告中提取 25 个字段，并与前瞻性维护的临床数据库进行对比；同时与两个生成式模型进行比较：本地运行的 Qwen3.5 9B 和通过云端 API 运行的 GLM-5.3-flash。Tev1 的平均字段准确率达到 0.917（95% CI 0.913–0.920），与 Qwen3.5 9B 相当（0.918；p = 0.26），且速度快四倍（每份报告 15 秒对 61 秒）。Nimble 达到 0.862，GLM-5.3-flash 达到 0.986。两个决策模型在简单的二分类项目上与 GLM-5.3-flash 表现相当，但在被分箱为类别的测量值、以及正确答案未在报告中明确表述的字段上表现较弱。

arXiv:2611.20129v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decision models are a new class of language model that, instead of generating text, choose one option per question from a fixed list and return a probability for every option. They have not yet been evaluated on clinical text. We evaluated two open-weights decision models, Nimble 9B and Tev1 4B, for extracting 25 fields from 1,113 oral cavity cancer pathology reports from a single centre, against a prospectively maintained clinical database. We compared them with two generative models: Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, and GLM-5.3-flash, run through a cloud API. Tev1 reached a mean field accuracy of 0.917 (95% CI 0.913 to 0.920), the same as Qwen3.5 9B (0.918; p = 0.26), and was four times faster (15 s against 61 s per report). Nimble reached 0.862 and GLM-5.3-flash 0.986. Both decision models matched GLM-5.3-flash on simple dichotomous categories. They were weak on measurements binned into categories, on fields whose correct answer was not rep

item.title: 提出质量感知的跨模态潜在填补与融合框架QA-CMIF，通过逐通道独立编码、软门控可靠性评估、置信度加权残差旁路保护完好通道以及跨注意力填补修复退化通道，实现对电极故障容错的精准轻量级sEMG-惯性手部手势识别。
item.description:
QA-CMIF：面向容错式表面肌电-惯性手部手势识别的精准且轻量的跨模态潜在填补与融合方法

QA-CMIF:Accurate and Lightweight Cross-Modal Latent Imputation and Fusion for Fault-Tolerant sEMG-Inertial Hand Gesture Recognition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20124

提出质量感知的跨模态潜在填补与融合框架QA-CMIF，通过逐通道独立编码、软门控可靠性评估、置信度加权残差旁路保护完好通道以及跨注意力填补修复退化通道，实现对电极故障容错的精准轻量级sEMG-惯性手部手势识别。

将表面肌电信号与惯性测量数据融合被广泛应用于肌电假肢控制和可穿戴人机接口。然而在日常佩戴中，电极座的微小位移、电极脱落以及导线故障，常会以突发伪影、脱落冲击或断路失效的形式破坏未知部分的sEMG通道。现有的融合网络在第一层卷积层就将所有通道混合，导致少数受损电极污染整个潜在表示；而仅对受损通道进行门控衰减的做法，又会丢弃区分细粒度手势所需的协同激活线索。我们提出了QA-CMIF，一个质量感知的跨模态潜在填补与融合框架：它对每个sEMG通道进行独立编码，通过软门控评估通道可靠性，并利用置信度加权的残差旁路保护完好通道，同时由跨注意力填补器在潜在空间中修复退化通道（原文摘要至此截断）。

arXiv:2611.20124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fusing surface electromyography (sEMG) with inertial measurements is widely used for myoelectric prosthesis control and wearable human-machine interfaces. In daily wear, however, socket micro-displacement, electrode lift-off, and wire failures often corrupt an unknown subset of sEMG channels through burst artifacts, lift-off shocks, or open-circuit dropouts. Existing fusion networks mix all channels in the first convolutional layer, so a few corrupted electrodes contaminate the entire latent representation, whereas gate-only attenuation of corrupted channels discards the co-activation cues needed to separate fine-grained gestures. We propose QA-CMIF, a quality-aware cross-modal latent imputation and fusion framework that encodes each sEMG channel independently, scores its reliability with a soft gate, and protects intact channels via a confidence-weighted residual bypass, while a cross-attention imputer repairs degraded channels in laten

item.title: CECAR提出缓存与专家协同感知的路由系统，通过机器学习预测专家重用距离并优先路由重用距离较小的专家，从而加速资源受限设备上的MoE大语言模型推理。
item.description:
CECAR：缓存与专家协同感知路由加速MoE大语言模型的端侧推理

CECAR: Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing Accelerates On-Device Inference of MoE LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20119

CECAR提出缓存与专家协同感知的路由系统，通过机器学习预测专家重用距离并优先路由重用距离较小的专家，从而加速资源受限设备上的MoE大语言模型推理。

尽管端侧LLM部署日益受到关注，但大规模混合专家（MoE）模型在资源受限的设备上仍然不实用，因为稀疏的专家激活仍要求所有专家权重驻留在内存中。为解决这一问题，我们识别出端侧MoE推理的三个关键观察：(a) 即使在Belady最优策略下，缓存命中率也存在根本性上限；(b) 这些上限不足以支撑低延迟的端侧推理；(c) 先前基于二值缓存存在性的缓存感知路由可能引发路由不稳定。基于这些洞察，我们提出了CECAR（缓存与专家协同感知路由），这是一个联合考虑专家路由与缓存管理的MoE推理系统。与先前的缓存感知路由方法不同，CECAR使用基于机器学习的缓存策略来预测每个专家的预期重用距离，并将路由和执行优先指向预测重用距离较小的专家。

arXiv:2611.20119v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Despite growing interest in on-device LLM deployment, large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remain impractical on resource-constrained devices, as sparse expert activation still requires all expert weights to be memory-resident. To address this, we identify three key observations for on-device MoE inference: (a) cache hit rates are fundamentally bounded even under Belady's optimal policy; (b) these bounds are insufficient for low-latency on-device inference; and (c) prior cache-aware routing based on binary cache presence can induce routing instability. Based on these insights, we propose CECAR (Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing), a MoE inference system that jointly considers expert routing and cache management. Unlike prior cache-aware routing methods, CECAR uses an ML-based cache policy to predict the expected reuse distance of each expert and prioritizes routing and execution toward experts with smaller predicted reuse distances

item.title: 提出一种即插即用的能量平衡结冰模块，将叶片能量平衡物理直接嵌入Transformer的模型结构中，在无需叶片传感器输入的条件下实现可靠的霜冻结冰概率临近预报。
item.description:
一种无需叶片传感器输入的即插即用能量平衡结冰模块，用于Transformer霜冻临近预报

A plug-in energy-balance freezing module for transformer frost nowcasting without leaf-sensor inputs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20114

提出一种即插即用的能量平衡结冰模块，将叶片能量平衡物理直接嵌入Transformer的模型结构中，在无需叶片传感器输入的条件下实现可靠的霜冻结冰概率临近预报。

霜冻防护需要在无法获得叶片传感器输入的情况下进行本地化预警。在我们调研的霜冻相关文献中，物理知识是通过输入、数值模式耦合或损失函数进入机器学习模型的，而非通过模型结构本身。我们开发了一个与Transformer兼容的模块，将叶片能量平衡物理嵌入结冰概率预报中：由能量平衡温度参考项与一个可学习的残差共同预测叶片温度，该温度进而驱动一个乘性门控，施加依赖于温度的概率上限。我们从数学上证明了条件单调性与警报边界，并检验了将相同信息置于输出通路或注意力机制中是否会带来不同的收益。我们在韩国19个站点、五个霜冻季上评估了12个逐小时预报时效，分别在有和没有叶片传感器输入的情况下进行测试。在无这些输入的2025-2026保留测试季中，我们的时间token Transformer（PET-E）在各预报时效平均上达到了临界（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.20114v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Frost protection requires local warnings where leaf-sensor inputs are unavailable. In the frost literature we surveyed, physics entered machine-learning models through inputs, numerical-model coupling, or losses, rather than model structure. We develop a transformer-compatible module that embeds leaf energy-balance physics in freezing-probability forecasts: an energy-balance temperature reference and a learned residual predict leaf temperature, which drives a multiplicative gate imposing a temperature-dependent probability cap. We mathematically prove conditional monotonicity and an alarm boundary, and test whether placing the same information in the output pathway or in attention yields different benefits. We evaluated 12 hourly leads at 19 Korean stations over five frost seasons, with and without leaf-sensor inputs. item.title: 该论文提出基于集合数据同化的回声状态网络无清洗部署方法，在部分观测、含噪声且低采样率的条件下实现储备池状态与系统的同步，并可推断物理参数、量化预测不确定性以及预测高维混沌系统。
item.description:
回声状态网络的无清洗同步、参数估计与不确定性量化

Washout-free synchronization, parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification of echo state networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20112

该论文提出基于集合数据同化的回声状态网络无清洗部署方法，在部分观测、含噪声且低采样率的条件下实现储备池状态与系统的同步，并可推断物理参数、量化预测不确定性以及预测高维混沌系统。

回声状态网络（ESN）能够在多个李雅普诺夫时间内预测混沌系统。与所有循环网络一样，ESN在预测之前需要一个“清洗”阶段，即一个完整状态驱动网络直至储备池状态与系统同步的阶段。然而在部署时，传感器仅能测量状态的一部分，且带有噪声，采样率也低于训练数据。我们提出通过集合数据同化实现ESN的无清洗部署。在闭环模式下，ESN是一个马尔可夫动力系统；因此，只要数据可用，序贯滤波器就可以校正其储备池状态。该滤波器将从训练数据中提取的储备池状态集合与系统同步，并量化预测的不确定性。我们将该方法扩展到参数化ESN以推断物理参数，并扩展到带局部化技术的并行ESN以预测高维系统。我们在Lorenz-63和…系统上测试了该方法。

arXiv:2611.20112v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Echo state networks (ESNs) forecast chaotic systems for several Lyapunov times. Like all recurrent networks, ESNs require a washout before forecasting, i.e., a phase in which the full state drives the network until the reservoir state synchronizes with the system. At deployment, however, sensors measure only part of the state, with noise and at a lower sampling rate than the training data. We propose a washout-free deployment of ESNs via ensemble data assimilation. In closed loop, the ESN is a Markovian dynamical system; hence, a sequential filter can correct its reservoir state whenever data are available. The filter synchronizes an ensemble of reservoir states, drawn from the training data, with the system, and quantifies the forecast uncertainty. We extend the method to parametric ESNs, to infer physical parameters, and to parallel ESNs with localization, to forecast high-dimensional systems. We test the method on the Lorenz-63 and

item.title: 本文提出MT-RGCN-DTI模型，通过整合药物-靶点相互作用网络、药物相似性网络和蛋白质相似性网络构建异构信息网络，并结合RGCN与DistMult、ComplEx知识图谱嵌入解码器，实现多任务药物-靶点相互作用预测。
item.description:
MT-RGCN-DTI：一种用于药物-靶点相互作用预测的多任务关系图卷积网络

MT-RGCN-DTI: A Multi-Task Relational Graph Convolutional Network for Drug-Target Interaction Prediction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20109

本文提出MT-RGCN-DTI模型，通过整合药物-靶点相互作用网络、药物相似性网络和蛋白质相似性网络构建异构信息网络，并结合RGCN与DistMult、ComplEx知识图谱嵌入解码器，实现多任务药物-靶点相互作用预测。

药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）预测已成为药物发现中至关重要的组成部分。随着数据量的不断增长，通过整合多种数据源来提高预测准确性变得非常重要。在这方面，以异构信息网络的形式利用多种资源来解决DTI预测问题可能带来显著收益。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于异构信息网络的多任务DTI预测模型，该模型充分发挥了关系图卷积网络（RGCN）的优势。为实现这一目标，该模型利用药物-靶点相互作用网络、药物-药物相似性网络和蛋白质-蛋白质相似性网络来构建异构信息网络。此外，我们使用知识图谱嵌入评分函数来建模药物与靶点之间的相互作用，具体而言，将DistMult和ComplEx作为解码器作用于学习到的节点表示之上。我们进行了广泛的（实验验证，摘要原文在此处截断）……

arXiv:2611.20109v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Prediction of drug-target interaction (DTI) has become a very crucial part of drug discovery. With the increase in the data volume, it has become very important to improve prediction accuracy by integrating multiple data sources. In this regard, utilising multiple resources in the form of heterogeneous information network to address DTI prediction can be rewarding. In this work, we propose a heterogeneous information network based multi-task DTI prediction model which leverages the advantages of relation graph convolutional network (RGCN). To achieve this, the model employs drug-target interaction network, drug-drug similarity network and protein-protein similarity network to construct a heterogeneous information network. Moreover, we use a knowledge graph embedding scoring functions to model interactions between drug and targets, specifically DistMult and ComplEx as decoders over the learned node representations. item.title: 该论文提出一种状态感知的服务引擎，在每次推理遍历时根据离线测量的交叉点在持久化巨型内核与融合内核链之间动态选择，使Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe在H100上达到4,345倍实时的吞吐量（为vLLM的1.39倍），并在相同的400毫秒延迟预算下支持8倍的并发请求数量。
item.description:
基于状态感知巨型内核与内核融合的Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe高吞吐量服务

High-Throughput Serving of Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe with Regime-Aware Megakernels and Kernel Fusion

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20095

该论文提出一种状态感知的服务引擎，在每次推理遍历时根据离线测量的交叉点在持久化巨型内核与融合内核链之间动态选择，使Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe在H100上达到4,345倍实时的吞吐量（为vLLM的1.39倍），并在相同的400毫秒延迟预算下支持8倍的并发请求数量。

Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe在Hugging Face开放权重模型Open ASR排行榜上排名第一。高效地服务该模型不仅仅是需要快速的算子：连续批处理会在每次迭代中改变工作量和任务组合方式，最佳融合粒度也随之变化。我们提出了一种服务引擎，它在每次推理遍历时，根据离线测量得到的交叉点，在持久化巨型内核和融合内核链之间进行选择。在H100 SXM GPU上，我们这种保持精度的服务方案峰值吞吐量达到4,345倍实时速度，是调优后vLLM峰值的1.39倍，在低并发场景下最高快4.39倍；在B200上峰值达到6,367倍实时速度，在我们测量的最高并发下是vLLM的1.64倍。词错误率（WER）为1.91%至1.93%，而vLLM为1.88%至1.93%。在p95端到端完成时间400毫秒的预算内，它可服务的并发请求数量是原来的8倍。每次遍历动态选择比单独使用任一策略都更好：比始终使用巨型内核的吞吐量高出23%。

arXiv:2611.20095v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe ranks first among open-weight models on the Hugging Face Open ASR leaderboards. Serving it efficiently takes more than fast operators: continuous batching changes the amount and mix of work at every iteration, and the best fusion granularity changes with it. We present a serving engine that, for every pass, chooses between persistent megakernels and chains of fused kernels at crossovers measured offline. On an H100 SXM GPU, throughput of our accuracy-preserving serving peaks at 4,345x real time, 1.39x the peak of tuned vLLM, and is up to 4.39x faster at low concurrency; on B200 it peaks at 6,367x, 1.64x vLLM at the highest concurrency we measured. Word error rate (WER) is 1.91 to 1.93% against 1.88 to 1.93% for vLLM. Within a 400 ms budget for p95 end-to-end completion time, it serves 8x as many concurrent requests. item.title: 本文实证验证了两个任务梯度场的李括号决定了训练顺序导致的权重差异并与灾难性遗忘相关，且仅凭旧任务训练结束时存储的梯度和前20个Hessian特征对，就能在无需旧数据的条件下早期预测遗忘，效果优于EWC惩罚项。
item.description:
学习顺序能否解释遗忘？李括号作为无需旧数据的灾难性遗忘早期预警信号

Does Learning Order Explain Forgetting? The Lie Bracket as an Early-Warning Signal for Catastrophic Forgetting Without Old Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20087

本文实证验证了两个任务梯度场的李括号决定了训练顺序导致的权重差异并与灾难性遗忘相关，且仅凭旧任务训练结束时存储的梯度和前20个Hessian特征对，就能在无需旧数据的条件下早期预测遗忘，效果优于EWC惩罚项。

先在任务A上训练、再在任务B上训练的网络，其最终权重与先训练B再训练A的网络不同。在主导阶上，这一差距由两个任务梯度场的李括号（Lie bracket）决定，Dherin (2023) 猜想非零的李括号可能与灾难性遗忘相关。本文对这一猜想进行了实证检验。在Split MNIST、Split Fashion-MNIST 和 Split CIFAR-10 上，任务A的遗忘几乎恰好等于两种训练顺序下A的损失之差（Spearman rho = 0.96-1.00）。随后，作者进一步探究李括号能否在任务B训练早期、且不使用A的任何数据的情况下预测遗忘——仅利用A训练结束时存储的小型摘要信息：其梯度及其前20个Hessian特征对。当旧任务已被充分学习且遗忘较慢（任务增量式学习）时，这个存储的李括号对遗忘的排序相关系数达到 rho = 0.70-0.81，而 Elastic Weight Consolidation（EWC）惩罚项仅为 0.33-0.58，并且匹配或超过（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.20087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A network trained on task A and then task B ends at different weights than one trained on B and then A. To leading order this gap is set by the Lie bracket of the two tasks' gradient fields, and Dherin (2023) conjectured that a non-vanishing bracket may be linked to catastrophic forgetting. I test this conjecture empirically. Across Split MNIST, Split Fashion-MNIST and Split CIFAR-10, the forgetting of A is almost exactly the difference in A's loss between the two training orders (Spearman rho = 0.96-1.00). I then ask whether the bracket can predict that forgetting early in training on B and without any of A's data, using only a small summary stored when A finishes: its gradient and its top 20 Hessian eigenpairs. item.title: 该论文提出一种基于Transformer注意力机制的路侧基础设施多智能体强化学习框架，通过V2I通信让路侧控制器聚合所有协同自动驾驶车辆的状态并下发控制指令，以在密集交通下实现安全高效的高速公路匝道合流。
item.description:
基于基础设施与注意力机制的多智能体强化学习用于高速公路匝道合流

Infrastructure-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Attention for Highway Ramp Merging

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20078

该论文提出一种基于Transformer注意力机制的路侧基础设施多智能体强化学习框架，通过V2I通信让路侧控制器聚合所有协同自动驾驶车辆的状态并下发控制指令，以在密集交通下实现安全高效的高速公路匝道合流。

匝道合流是高速公路上典型的安全与通行效率问题。在缺乏适当协调的情况下，人类驾驶员和自利的自动驾驶车辆可能做出危险的驾驶操作，从而引发事故或拥堵。随着协同自动驾驶车辆（CAV）和多智能体强化学习（MARL）的最新进展，可以对车辆进行训练以实现安全高效的合流协调。然而，在密集交通中，构建对交通状态的有效观测极具挑战性。例如，仅观测邻近车辆可能导致局部最优决策，而观测整个交通状况又会引入大量无关信息。本文提出了一种基于Transformer的MARL车辆控制模型来解决这些问题。路侧基础设施控制器通过车路协同（V2I）通信接收所有协同自动驾驶车辆的状态，并向它们回传控制指令。基于注意力的观测机制……

arXiv:2611.20078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On-ramp merging is a typical safety and throughput problem on highways. Without proper coordination, human drivers and self-interested autonomous vehicles may make risky manoeuvres and cause accidents or congestion. With recent advances in connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), vehicles can be trained to coordinate for safe and efficient merging. However, in dense traffic, forming an effective observation of the traffic state is challenging. For example, observing only the neighbouring vehicles may lead to locally optimal decisions, while observing the entire traffic can introduce much irrelevant information. In this paper, we propose a transformer-based MARL vehicle control model to address these problems. item.description:
移动平台着陆中掩码条件视觉强化学习的提示词重新指定与目标掩码可用性

Prompt Re-Specification and Target-Mask Availability in Mask-Conditioned Visual Reinforcement Learning for Moving-Platform Landing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20075

仅通过重新指定文本提示词而无需更新任何策略权重，冻结的掩码条件视觉强化学习无人机着陆策略即可适应外观新颖的着陆平台，将成功率从 12.0% 恢复至 68.4%。

视觉强化学习（RL）策略在将无人机降落到移动平台时，如果着陆平台的外观与训练时使用的不同，可能会失败。使用二值目标掩码作为视觉输入，可以去除大部分像素级外观信息，同时保留目标的空间表示，并允许通过文本提示来指定目标。在仿真中，我们测试了冻结（固定权重）的基于掩码的 DrQ-v2 策略，在仅改变其微调的 SAM 3 检测器提示词的情况下，能否应对新的着陆平台。一个香蕉主题的着陆平台将着陆成功率从 75.6% 降低到 12.0%，并且在原始提示词下 SAM 3 很少能检测到它。在测试了多个候选提示词后选定的修改版提示词，在没有任何权重更新的情况下，将成功率恢复到了 68.4%。在使用真实掩码训练的策略进行的另一项独立实验中，当平台可见时填补缺失的掩码，对比测试的掩码质心和面积相关性方法，对成功着陆的帮助要大得多。

arXiv:2611.20075v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Visual reinforcement learning (RL) policies that land a drone on a moving platform can fail when the landing pad looks different from the one used in training. Using binary target masks as the visual input removes most pixel-level appearance information while preserving the spatial representation of the target, and lets a text prompt specify the target. In simulation, we test whether a frozen (fixed-weight) mask-based DrQ-v2 policy can handle a new pad when only the prompt of its fine-tuned SAM 3 detector changes. A banana-themed pad lowered landing success from 75.6% to 12.0%, and SAM 3 rarely detected it under the original prompt. A revised prompt, chosen after testing several candidates, restored success to 68.4% with no weight updates. In a separate experiment with a policy trained on ground-truth masks, filling in masks that were missing while the pad was visible helped landing far more than the tested mask-centroid and area corre

item.title: 该论文提出了一种将两层Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的边缘函数存为128项查找表的KAN-LUT软解映射器，仅需查表、线性插值和加法即可在非线性卫星APSK链路上低成本生成准确的比特LLR，性能与LogMAP-CG相差不到0.2 dB，且计算成本随调制阶数升高从87%降至27%。
item.description:
面向非线性卫星链路幅度相移键控的Kolmogorov-Arnold查找表解映射器

Kolmogorov-Arnold Lookup Table Demappers for Amplitude Phase-Shift Keying over Nonlinear Satellite Links

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20068

该论文提出了一种将两层Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的边缘函数存为128项查找表的KAN-LUT软解映射器，仅需查表、线性插值和加法即可在非线性卫星APSK链路上低成本生成准确的比特LLR，性能与LogMAP-CG相差不到0.2 dB，且计算成本随调制阶数升高从87%降至27%。

下一代高通量卫星越来越多地在星上完成解调和译码，因此接收机每符号的处理成本限制了载荷功耗与吞吐量。面向非线性卫星链路的软解映射器必须以低成本产生准确的比特对数似然比（LLR）。我们提出了一种KAN-LUT解映射器，即一个两层的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN），其学习到的单变量边缘函数被存储为128项的查找表（LUT），使得推理过程只需要查表、线性插值和加法运算。我们对查找表引入的LLR误差进行了理论界定，并在采用低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）编码和非线性行波管放大器的幅度相移键控（APSK）链路上对该解映射器进行了评估。对于16、32和64-APSK，KAN-LUT与基于簇的高斯log-MAP（LogMAP-CG）解映射器相比性能差距保持在0.2 dB以内，而其相对于LogMAP-CG的成本随调制阶数增加从87%降至27%。它匹配或……（原文摘要截断于此）

arXiv:2611.20068v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Next-generation high-throughput satellites increasingly demodulate and decode on board, so the per-symbol cost of the receiver constrains payload power and throughput. Soft demappers for nonlinear satellite links must therefore produce accurate bit log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) at low cost. We introduce a KAN-LUT demapper, a two-layer Kolmogorov--Arnold network (KAN) whose learned univariate edge functions are stored as 128-entry lookup tables (LUTs), so that inference needs only table reads, linear interpolation, and additions. We bound the LLR error introduced by the tables and evaluate the demapper on amplitude phase-shift keying (APSK) links with low-density parity-check (LDPC) coding and a nonlinear traveling-wave-tube amplifier. For 16-, 32-, and 64-APSK, KAN-LUT stays within 0.2 dB of a per-cluster Gaussian log-MAP (LogMAP-CG) demapper, while its cost relative to LogMAP-CG falls from 87% to 27% as the order grows.
